Sunset. Corabb, Dunsparrow, and Leoman are waiting in Leoman’s inner sanctum. The Malazans have not made a move
Leoman feels confident. He wants to put up a front like they're trying but not stage men at the walls, all of which confuses Corabb
Leoman tasks Corabb to watch his back, Corabb thinks he's going to the frontlines and Dunsparrow laughs at him
Pearl lounges on silk pillows smoking wine-flavoured hookah
Pearl says he could easily sneak in and assassinate Leoman, but Tavore doesn't want his help
[Note: Loyal to Empress Laseen, not Tavore]
Pearl is tempted to reveal the truth to Tavore that Sha'ik was her sister Felisin
Empress Laseen only commands for Pearl to wait and see
Lostara Yil insists and is allowed the join the siege against Y’Ghatan

A Pardu woman from Ehrlitan. She was abandoned by her parents because they wanted a boy. She avoided the orphanages as much as she could before she was kidnapped into a Rashan temple by the age of 7, onlookers watched and did nothing as she was dragged and screaming for help
She had custodial duties until she was picked to become a Shadow Dancer. Bidithal was one of her masters.
At age 14-15, High Priest Delat (Quick Ben) had come to observe Shadow Dancers perform the Song of the Reeds, Lostara Yil caught his eye. Her dance seemed more sensual than the others.
Later that night Quick Ben, as a Bridgeburner, killed everyone in the temple except Lostara Yil. Bidithal survived and joined Sha’ik’s cult
Later on, Lostara Yil joined the Red Blades to enforce Malazan justice
Lostara Yil was with Tene Baralta (later Fist in the Malaz 14th Army) when they stalked Kalam delivering the Holy Book of Dryjnha to Sha’ik. Lostara Yil herself is the one that killed Sha’ik Elder.

While continuing to follow Kalam, the Claw agent Pearl joined her into the imperial warren. They made a short detour to assist Fist Coltaine, nearly dying to kill a Semk godling. They were rescued by Apt and Panek.

Pearl saves her and takes her back to an inn in Aren. When she leaves to report back to her Red Blades commander Orto Setral, she was arrested with the rest of by High Fist Pormqual who suspected all Red Blades were committing treason against the Malazan Empire

After the Red Blades were freed and placed under Adjunct Tavore’s command, Claw agent Pearl had her accompany him in their mission to find Tavore’s missing sister, Felisin Paran. To appeal to Lostara, the mission would also find Talon agent, Baudin, to hand over to the Empress

Cotillion asks for her help in finding the Master of the Talon (Korbolo Dom), revealing he was present in watching her Shadow Dance for Quick Ben and that he nearly took her and made her a Bridgeburner
Lostara and Pearl interview Sgt. Gesler’s squad. Pella tells her about Felisin in the otataral mines. The rest tell her of their journey through the Nascent and the Tellann warren

The pair travel through the imperial warren, where they just happened across an otataral dragon crucified on an X-cross. They find and enter a gate in Kurald Thyrllan (Tiste Liosan) where they stand on crystal and find a pyramid that had the names of the dragons that imprisoned the otataral dragon.
Pearl (somehow) teleports them into a T’lan Imass cave containing Olay Shayn, a T’lan Imass who hunted the Unbound and confirmed that the T’lan Imass successfully killed the Tiste Liosan’s false god
A bird-like demon that was L’oric’s best friend. He was a stand in for Osric who just fucked off and didn’t care for his son or Tiste Liosan worshipers

Pearl performs a ritual to speak with an earth spirit, that led them to the site where Baudin died to Gryllen, the rat d’ivers and Sha’ik’s site of death. They surmise that Felisin survived and became Sha’ik’s imposter
When they reached the Whirlwind wall, they slept together and then she knocked Pearl unconscious. Cotillion advised her to stay out of the Battle of Raraku
After the Battle, they both arrived to late to have found Felisin dead at Tavore’s feet. They take Felisin’s body and bury it in secret

cards.h: Scene 3, 4, 5 (Y’Ghatan outskirts, Keneb, Lt. Pores, Sgt. Hellian)

i.html: Fist Keneb, Fist Tene Baralta, and squads are gathering at the northern picket area, just few men enough to hide their intentions
Tene Baralta is in full armour. Scaled vest, chain skirt and camail, bronze greaves and vambraces lined with iron, a strapped helm
Fist Blistig is to stay behind as emergency reinforcement
Temul’s plan matches Tavore’s plan
Nil and Nether sense no mages in Y’Ghatan
Rumours of plague in Ehrlitan puts a timer on the siege to end it before the plague reaches them
A rider with a light grey cloak, white horse, and longsword scabbard banded in white enamel rides quickly through the Malazan camps and into a gate
Tene Baralta is upset to let an enemy ride through their camp with no consequences
Keneb notices Tene Baralta prays to Treach, already discarded Fener from his mind
Lt. Pores watched as Cpt. Kindly unable to take measure of Cpt. Faradan Sort as a person and commander
Lt. Pores smiles at his own jokes, Cpt. Kindly threatens to promote him, Lt. Pores apologizes
Cpt. Faradan Sort calls them idiots
Sgt. Hellian is drunken mess, traded away her sword for a jug of alcohol
Her squad only consists of herself, Cpl. Urb, and the twins Touchy and Brethless
They all feel anxious, the twins wanted city guard positions to avoid actual war
The rest were reassigned to other squads

cards.h: Scene 6, 7, 8 (Y’Ghatan outskirts, Sgt. Balm, Lutes, Fiddler)

i.html: Sgt. Balm [Note: The Dal Honese death dirge guy] was in the middle of losing a troughs/chess game with Sgt. Moak, their soldiers watching him
He has a mental breakdown. Doesn’t know where he is, what he's doing, or why he's wearing a clay death mask which he tears off
Balm tosses the game board and causes a commotion,
Sgt. Moak is angry but his Cpl. Stacker says Balm has the Confusion that afflicts soldiers right before battle. Similar to Fist Gamet
Sgt. Balm’s squad comes to bail him out
Cpl. Deadsmell, Throatslitter, Widdershins, Galt, and Lobe
Deadsmell thinks Sgt. Balm was smart to fake the Confusion and bail out of a losing game, Balm doesn't know what he's talking about
Lutes feels anxious and nauseous before the battle, Maybe describes how he's going in with the sappers and all the possible ways he could die. Lutes runs off to vomit
Gesler, Fiddler, Cuttle, Truth, and Pella sit around a campfire drinking tea watching the other soldiers break down from anxiety
Pella describes the soldiers at the Skullcup mines managed to fight bravely, though ultimately outnumbered and most died
Sgt. Borduke marched off frustrated that all his soldiers are vomiting
Bottle watched the veterans break down the same as everyone else
From spying on the mage gathering, he learned muted priestly magic gathered in Y’Ghatan
Bottle planned to use Meanas to conjure rolling mists to cover the sappers
Easily dispellable, but he knew there were no mages among the enemy
But he wouldn't be able to use spirit magic and spy inside the walls either
Bottle watched Sgt. Fiddler’s squad prepare
Cuttle tells the sappers it's time
Leoman dismisses eleven fanatical, drug-addled warriors to fight until their deaths
Corabb it's having a crisis as Leoman continue to speak Dryjhna’s name while bargaining with the Queen of Dreams
L’oric enters the hall, summoned by the Queen of Dreams, Leoman says he's part of the deal
They go to the South Tower
The sappers and mages get ready. Lots of people Bottle didn't even know were sappers until now
Bottle
Cuttle, Maybe, Crump, Ramp, and Widdershins
Balgrid
Taffo, Able, Gupp, Jump, and Bowl
This is the first time sappers are facing Malazan-built fortifications, after Y’Ghatan switched hands and was reconstructed numerous times
Ebron, from the Ashok Regiment, comes to warn Bottle that Crump was from the Mott Irregulars and he is crazy dangerous
Bottle begins casting his sorcery
Begins with a mental image of the Meanas warren, a swirling wall. Focusing a red wound form and burning through
Power poured into him, which he didn't want. [Someone else’s?]
Bottle then has the realization that the wall is only ever a mental image to assist in breaching the warren
Power is blood. Blood is power. And this blood, it belongs to an Elder God…
Inky mists covered the ground, the sappers moved into it
The mist was only one-sided. The sappers could see perfectly and don't see the mist
Only true masters could cheat light in all directions. Bottle only dabbled. Balgrid barely is managing to do so
Wagon-planks are thrown to cross the moats. They approach closer
Chapter 7 Scene 12 (Y’Ghatan outskirts,
Lostara Yil)
Lostara Yil stands next to Fist Tene Baralta, the Red Blades reunited
Lostara is excited to fight and leave Pearl behind
Pella watches Sgt. Gesler talk with Sgt. Borduke, both who lost men to sapper or magic duties
Gesler looks bored, only has Pella and Truth
Borduke looks nervous as hell, has Cpl. Hubb, Lutes, and Ibb
Pella wonders at Gesler, Stormy, and Truth’s gold skin
Their ship, the Silanda, was with the fleet in or near Kansu harbor
Pella regrets becoming a soldier
Chapter 7 Scene 14 (Y’Ghatan, Corabb)
Leoman takes L’oric, Dunsparrow, Corabb, and a guard to stand on a tower to watch lantern lights from several rooftops making signals that they're ready
Leoman is excited and thinks his plan might work
As the sappers reach Y’Ghatan’s wall, Cuttle steps into a wasp nest and is stung. One leg is numb
The sappers dig out holes and to place wall-breakers, bundles made of round cussers and spiked crackers
Crump, of Sgt. Cord’s squad and the Mott Irregular, places three wall-breakers
When Cuttle orders him to dismantle them, Crump instead detonates them way too soon
Bottle helps Cuttle run away on his bad knee and try to hide behind cover
Cuttle only counted down to 8 before it exploded
Chapter 7 Scene 16 (Malazan Camps, Lostara
Yil)
Lostara Yil watches as the shockwave of the wall-breakers knocks all of the soldiers gathering at the northern pickets fall down
The explosion sprayed waves of rocks at the soldiers, enough to break bones
The gap in the wall crumpled, and two and three story residential buildings are on fire
Bottle gets up, unscathed, and finds Cuttle who can feel his leg again
Cuttle only counted to 8 to get people’s hopes up that they can make it
Other soldiers were getting up and coughing
A third of the south wall was destroyed
The scene is illuminated despite being night time
Chapter 7 Scene 18 (Malazan camp, Keneb)
Fist Keneb orders Cpt. Faradan Sort to send the heavies as backup for the marines that already went in
Fist Tene Baralta and Lostara Yil are moving in
Adjunct Tavore, T’amber, Nil, Nether, Fist Blistig, and Warleader Gall are standing together watching
Fist Temul leads the Wickan Crow Clan and Khundryl Burned Tears to the other side of the city incase Leoman tries to flee
Fist Keneb orders Sgt. Cord to lead the medium soldiers to for street and alley fighting
Sgt. Cord still wears the Ashok Regiment patch
The Malaz 14th Army is heading into true battle for the first time
‘Hood look away from us this night. Just look away’
Bottle and Cuttle returned to Sgt. Fiddler’s squad, followed Sgt. Borduke’s squad into the city
Formation
Koryk & Tarr (front), Fiddler & Smiles, Bottle, Cuttle (rear)
Ran through and up out of Crump’s crater
Went through old city ruins and collapsed sections of the wall
The soldiers reach a section with a large fissure in the floor that dropped the other side of the building slanted down to about a man’s height
Yellow birds painted on the tiles
Smiles dropped her rope, Fiddler punches her chin
Cuttle had picked it up, Koryk grabs it and jumps down to the lower section
The squad used to rope to carefully descend the slope
Sgt. Fiddler’s squad runs to Sgt. Borduke squad out into the streets where they get ambushed by arrows in all the open windows and doors, and warriors in the streets
Sgt. Borduke in the lead, is killed by arrows to his eye and throat ☠
Cpl. Hubb behind Borduke, is killed by an arrow to his gut ☠
Ibb is killed when he took an arrow to the left shoulder and a warrior struck his head with a scimitar ☠
Tavos Pond and Balgrid are alive
Lutes down but alive
Maybe
Sgt. Fiddler‘s squad fights with half a dozen warriors
Koryk parries a scimitar and stabs their throat

A screaming warrior lunged at Bottle trying to bite his neck, Bottle sensed his way into the warrior’s mind, found the ‘most primitive part of the brain’ where he surged a burst of power. The warrior falls limply to the ground, twitching
An arrow bounces off the back of Fiddler’s head, falling to his knees. Fiddler turns around and fires a munition round, collapsing the upper floor of a building
Sgt. Mosel’s squad appears next to the building right before Fiddler fired
Everyone is knocked to the ground, Cpl. Harbyn ☠
is next to Bottle. Lower half is missing, entrails spilled out
Sgt. Mosel approaches Fiddler, pissed at him because that building was there target
Fiddler instead directs them to another building before its archers start firing
Cpl. Tarr was half buried by the building, but his armor and shield saved him. Glad Fiddler blew up the building because they would've ended up like Sgt. Borduke’s squad
Sgt. Cord, still wearing the Ashok Regiment patch, arrives with his medium infantry
Fiddler wants Fist Keneb to send the sappers ahead with marines guarding them and take it one building at a time
Sgt. Cord sends Sinn, who just cut a finger off a dead body and put it in a pouch, to deliver Fiddler’s message
The soldiers get ready for the next street
Sgt. Gesler uses hand signs to slowly advance his squad (Truth, Pella, and Sands)
Sends the heavies in to clear the buildings and counter any potential ambushes
Sgt. Moak and Sgt. Tugg
Sends inexperienced sappers (decided to learn an hour before) in to take the buildings down
Sgt. Thom Thissy
Able, Jump, Gump
Chapter 7 Scene 21 (Y’Ghatan, Pella)
Pella was taking cover behind a wall, aiming his crossbow at a window
He gets distracted watching Sgt. Tugg squad enter a building on the other side of the street, and Sgt. Thom Tissy’s squad run into the building Pella was leaning against
Sgt. Thom Tissy’s inexperienced squad detonates their munitions
The window Pella was watching shoots their arrow and strikes Pella’s forehead, his knees skidded across the ground as he fell
Pella remembers how he skinned his knees, money saved up to move to the better part of the slums was instead spent on a healer
Pella dies ☠
‘Oh Momma, I skinned my knees. I'm sorry. I'm so sorry. I skinned my knees…’
Sgt. Gesler sees Pella die, as a burner munition engulfs the building Sgt. Thom Tissy’s inexperienced sapper squad ran into
A Malazan on fire, still wearing a bag of munitions, frantically runs out flailing
Sgt. Moak and his squad runs to put out the fire
Gesler shoots the Malazan to try to send him back and stop them but it was too late
Sgt. Moak ☠
, Stacker ☠
, Rove ☠
, Burnt ☠
, Guano ☠
, and Mud ☠
are blown to meat chunks and shattered bone
Able ☠
, Jump ☠
, and Gupp ☠
burned to death
Sgt. Gesler calls Truth over to him
Sgt. Thom Tissy, Tulip, and Ramp ran into the building with Sgt. Tugg’s squad
Sgt. Gesler and Truth follow
Inside, Sgt. Tugg was killed by a spear in the chest. Robello’s head is caved in ☠
Gesler, Truth, Tuggs, Tulip, and Ramp stay together
Cpl. Urb suddenly stops, Sgt. Hellian walks into him and falls on her butt
Hanno drops next to Hellian, saying how her squad lost Sgt. Sobelone ☠
and Toles ☠
Sgt. Hellian stands up straight, takes Hanno into her squad, and leads them to get revenge on the people that killed Hanno’s squadmates
Chapter 7 Scene 24 (Silk room, Balm)
Sgt. Balm survives an ambush and are the second floor of a building, in a room full of Darujhistan silks
Throatslitter, Deadsmell, and Widdershins finds casks of olive oil, with hollow walls recently set with clay
Galt and Lobe see the building across the street is filled with warriors, on the roof is a hooded figure with a lantern
Sgt. Balm’s squad realizes the entire city is a massive fire trap full of fanatics willing to die if they can kill the Malazans here
The squad tries to leave to inform Fist Keneb or any Cpt.
Fist Keneb and Fist Tene Baralta regrouped and together sent advances forces to take the city street by street
The enemy were drug addled fanatics and fought like they couldn't feel pain and only stopped when they died
Lostara Yil was sent ahead with three squads
Cpt. Faradan Sort was sent ahead to make contact with the advance forces to rendezvous by the palace
Keneb, Tene Baralta, and Cpt. Kindly were standing one street away from the breach in the wall the sappers opened
Suddenly, walls of fire appeared and soldiers were screaming
Urns if olive oil in enemy built trenches were exploding, splashing onto all soldiers nearby
Suicide bombers were on the roofs. Holding torches, flasks and amphorae tied around their body, legs tied to tall clay jugs
The suicide bombers kicked the jugs, dragging them down the the floor setting the olive oil on fire
The breach was destroyed and closed off, buildings were collapsing
No way out
Temul led the Wickan Crow Clan, the Khundryl Burned Tears, and the Seti to cut off the Northwest road to Lothal
No one from the city crossed their paths
Temul was satisfied that the Adjunct agreed with his plan to make a hard push into the heart of the city and end the war
Temul and all of the soldiers watch from a distance, Y’Ghatan bursting into walls of flames
He estimated a third of the Malaz 14th Army were inside the city by now. Good as dead
Chapter 7 Scene 27 (South of Y’Ghatan, Blistig)
Fist Blistig south of the city where the Malazans camped, feeling as helpless as he was in Aren when he could do nothing but watch Coltaine die
Adjunct Tavore orders the soldiers and warlocks to douse the breach
Nil and Nether can't. They don't have the power. The earth spirits are dying or fleeing
Something is about to be born
The sun starts to rise
Fist Keneb with about 800 wounded soldiers were trapped by walls of flame and geysers of olive oil
The air was hard to breathe, they were cooking in their own armor
Keneb struggles as he tries to take off his armor
Chapter 7 Scene 29 (Y’Ghatan streets, Lostara
Yil)
Lostara Yil with her kethra knives were able to defend herself and kill three enemy warriors
Fire and oil were all around her, she struggles to breathe
A building explodes with fire and falls towards Lostara Yil
A figure grabs her harness and pulls her back as she passes out
Sgt. Balm’s squad were lost and couldn't make it back to Fist Keneb, surrounded by fire everywhere
They passed the Falah’d’s palace
Sgt. Balm orders everyone to take off their armor before they bake themselves and toss their weapons
Widdershins believes a fire elemental is going to be born that'll burn fast and burn out quickly
Widdershins can attempt to make an illusion of a water elemental
Elementals though are still just theoretical
They all run into an alleyway
Chapter 7 Scene 31 (Y’Ghatan streets, Balm)
Cpt. Faradan Sort fires a crossbow at a soldier on fire, putting them out of their misery
Lt. Madan’Tul Rada had no ideas what to do

Sinn, the crazy girl from the Ashok Regiment, appears. Flames dancing in her hair. The fires around her extinguished as a black stain surrounded her. Her leathers, buckles, and claps fell and bounced off the ground as she walked
Cpt. Faradan Sort and Lt. Madan’Tul Rada follows her
Sgt. Hellian’s squad had taken off their armor and ditched their weapons
An upper level of a building simply slid off, crushing Bowl ☠
(of Sgt. Sobelone’s squad)
Cpl. Reem (of Sgt. Sobelone’s squad) joins them
Sgt. Hellian continues on into an alleyway
Her soldiers follow, despite their fear of another building falling, because there is nothing else to do
Sgt. Fiddler had brought all of his squad, and the surviving members of Sgt. Cord and Sgt. Borduke’s squads, to the palace
A suicide bomber approaches and the Malazans have no crossbows to stop him
A soldier named Bell ☠
sacrifices himself to stop the bomber
Sgt. Fiddler and Cuttle run to the palace to plant and detonate all of their munitions, except the burners, so the explosion would temporarily extinguish the surrounding flames and breach the door
Fiddler didn't see any fire behind the palace and thinks its a safe zone
Sgt. Gesler’s and Sgt. Thom Tissy’s squads appear
Gesler volunteers to take Sands’ munitions and help himself, but Truth intercepted the munitions and ran straight to the palace
Truth thinks their passing through the Tellann, Thyrllan, and Kurald Liosan warrens will help him survive
Truth also takes Fiddler and Cuttle’s munitions and runs in by himself
Gesler tries to run after Truth; Bottle, Fiddler, and Cuttle drag Gesler back
The munitions detonate, the intense wind and pressure blows away the wind and deafens the soldiers
Truth dies ☠
Fiddler screams and everyone runs into the palace
Corabb, Leoman, Dunsparrow, and L’oric approach the Queen of Dreams altar
Leoman, panicked, yells at L’oric to open the portal to the Queen of Dreams quickly
L’oric hesitates, saying the Queen of Dreams has no morals and threw away her heart long ago
Leoman assures him that he is not apart of the promises Leoman made with the Queen of Dreams
Corabb is having a crisis of faith in Leoman, as Leoman reveals he does not share the same faith in Dryjhna as the men he sent to die
Scalissara, the matron goddess of olives, would never have allowed this
On the altar of imported marble, a steaming pool of water. Its reflections manifested a portal that engulfed the entire altar
The Queen of Dreams greets L’oric as the son of Osserc, and says that she has chosen someone to take the position of Sha’ik before someone else less favorable does
L’oric accepts the duty to guard the new Sha’ik, the others are assumed to accept as well and enters the portal
Corabb Bhilan Thenu’alas rejects Leoman of the Flails, choosing to die here with his fellow warriors
The portal closes
Corabb hears screaming and pulls back curtains, revealing sixteen crying children
‘They have forgotten you. They all have. Every single one of them.’
The parents. The civilians. The warriors. The leaders. The priests. The gods. All of them have forgotten about the children and left them behind
Corabb takes them to find a room and wait out the firestorm
Throatslitter sees Sgt. Hellian’s squad up ahead, Sgt. Balm leads his squad to join with her
Chapter 7 Scene 36 (Y’Ghatan streets, Hellian)
Sgt. Balm and Sgt. Hellian group up, hoping the other would know where to go
Sgt. Hellian instead leads them down an alleyway towards anywhere that's not on fire
Throatslitter, holding his twin long knives, yells at her for calling Balm a Dal Honese monk-rat
Sgt. Hellian asks his name and tells him ‘Nice. Now go and slit your own throat’ and continues on
Sgt. Fiddler led the soldiers to the otherside of the palace into a market square
Apocalypse warriors emerge from the fires and attack
Shortnose and the female heavy infantry Mayfly, Flashwit, and Uru Hela form the frontline
A spear pierces Uru Hela’s shoulder knocking her down
The spear shaft cracks against Mayfly’s neck
A sword cuts off Tavos Pond’s face, eye hanging loose, he falls onto Bottle
A spear impales Fiddler’s leg
Ebron uses Meanas to conjure a black cloud, forming illusions that the Apocalypse warriors’ flesh is rotting off their bones
It was successful enough that the warriors fled right into fires that burned them
Koryk removes the spear from Fiddler and wraps his leg up
Sgt. Cord and Cpl. Tulip chase and tackle the running Tavos Pond and force his eye back into the socket
Sgt. Gesler orders everyone to get to the domed temple [of Scalissara]
Bottle’s fingers are turning blue, sign of hypoxia, they're not getting enough oxygen in their bloodstream
Fist Keneb is choking, crawling through the rubble
Sees a vision of a woman, a man, a man, and a child striding through the flames
Cpt. Faradan Sort grabs Keneb and tells him they have hundreds of soldiers around Sinn who can keep back the fire for a little bit longer
Fist Blistig was on his knees on the road by the Malazan encampment south of Y’Ghatan, watching the firestorm manifest about the city
Adjunct Tavore, in a panic, shouts orders to help the soldiers get out of the city
Grub, flanked by Bent and Roach, watched atop a slope
Khundryl, Wickans, witches, and warlocks moved forward
Sinn was maintaining a dark tunnel for the Malazans to escape the fires
‘Cool, sweet power - like a merciful god’s breath… emanation, this terrible beautiful will’
Nil sensed Sinn’s power, Nether recognized that Sinn was a High Mage and the girl doesn't even know it
A witch screamed and burst into flames, two other warlocks melted in white ash. Dying to help Sinn ward the flames
Tavore orders Grub to find officers, Grub immediately knows there’s 791 soldiers including Fist Keneb and Tene Baralta fleeing with Sinn
[Note: About 2,000 soldiers had entered Y’Ghatan]
Fist Blistig could do nothing but watch and sees a vision of a burning world
Corabb, leading the children in the temple, encounters Sgt. Hellian and other Malazan soldiers
Galt of Sgt. Balm’s squad introduces himself as Iuthural Galt, a Pardu
Sgt. Hellian orders Throatslitter to to kill him for staging the fire trap but Galt stops her
Corabb replies it was Leoman who betrayed the Apocalypse Army and left with L’oric and the Malazan woman Dunsparrow to the Queen of Dreams
A truce was made without words, the only enemy was the fire now
The rest of the Malazans with Sgt. Fiddler group up at the altar chamber
Corabb tosses aside his scimitar
Sgt. Gesler and Sgt. Hellian suggest beseeching the Queen of Dreams
The altar cracks after Crump pissed in the pool, proclaiming innocence for not using cussers before
Reveals himself to be former High Marshall Jamber Bole of the Mott Irregulars
In the room of sweltering heat of an oven, Bottle feel cool air rising beneath the floor tiles
Bottle got down on the floor and sent his senses down, finding rats fleeing through the ruins of caverns below
Brethless held out a cracker, a wedge-shaped copper sheathed spike
Cuttle takes the cracker, Corabb offered the sword he tossed away for Tulip to cut a hole into the floor
Cuttle places the cracker and tells everyone to covers their face, eyes, ears
Hellian asks him how many hands does he think they got, inciting laughter from everyone
Corabb stared like they lost their minds
The temple’s domed ceiling cracked and started to sag, flames from the firestorm above Y’Ghatan were seeping him
Cuttle detonates the cracker, deadly hail of stone chips and tile shards injured some
Bottle tries to sense a rat to lead them out, none are in his range or found a way out
‘Rats will flee. Even when there's nowhere to go.’
Fist Blistig watched all the burned soldiers be taken to the makeshift hospital tents with healers from the witches and warlocks
Flesh cracked open, lurid red. Cooked meat.
White ash of hair from limbs, eyebrows, blistered pates
Hands melted on weapon grips
Flames like a fire god burned above Y’Ghatan, the city itself melting into slag
Adjunct Tavore went to help with the wounded
Pearl stepped to Blistig’s side, eyes red from durhang and weeping [Lostara Yil], feeling no point in reporting to Empress Laseen. Reporting to Dujek will be enough
Blistig believes the history books will record this as a victory in annihilating the last vestiges of Sha'ik's rebellion, but the soldiers will know the Adjunct lost her first battle
Pearl knows Leoman escaped into the D’riss warren to the Queen of Dreams who is most unfathomable of all the other gods
Blistig walks away to the hospitals
Nearly no more air left to breathe in the Temple of Scalissara, its collapse imminent
Bottle possessed a rat trying to find a way out
Someone called Bottle’s name and distracts him, having to repossess a rat
Exploring further he finds what he thinks leads to a street
Sgt. Gesler orders everyone to adopt a child and have them between each soldier
Sgt. Fiddler and Corabb volunteers to stay at the rear and use the copper doors (that was used to seal the altar pool) to cover the tunnel behind them
Sgt. Hellian doesn't want to go down because of spiders. Cpl. Urb punches her jaw and knocks her out, while insisting she's genuinely a good sergeant
They fill their canteens and skins with the altar water

cards.h: Scene 45, 46, 47, 48, 49 (Underneath Y’Ghatan, Bottle, Smiles, Gesler, Tarr, Balm)

i.html: Bottle led the group to crawl through the low ceiling ruins of a buried street down into an old brick sewer
The children stopped crying, only sounds of effort and coughing breaking the silence
Smiles encouraged the girl in front of her to keep moving, the boy behind her was helping Tavos Pond
Behind them was Koryk chanting to calm himself, guessing he was claustrophobic after spending his life as a Seti tribesman on the savannahs
Sgt. Gesler was crawling through Tulip’s blood trail, periodically stopping because he was tickling Tulip’s feet
Crump crawled behind Gesler singing a song
Gesler feels guilty about Truth’s death
Cpl. Tarr pulled Balgrid through the tunnel, still somehow fat despite the march across the continent
Cpl. Urb threatens to cut Balgrid up like a pig
Sgt. Balm threatens the child in front of him to keep moving with crypt lizards that eat humans
Deadsmell tries to calm the boy down saying the lizards are tiny
Corabb and Sgt. Fiddler’s hands burned when they sealed the tunnel with the copper plates
The Temple of Scalissara collapses, heat bursts from behind the crawling train
Fiddler is buried in the rubble, Corabb pulls him out and tells him to grab onto his feet
Corabb drags Fiddler through the underground street into a pit
Bottle’s rat reaches the bottom of a very long vertical shaft with rough walls, he attempts to climb down himself
Two buildings with clashing styles, plaster with friezes and one with projections and elaborate ornamentation
Age check, Bottle confirmed to be 20 years old
Bottle leaned on a ledge of rotted wood that breaks, Bottle falls down the shaft and is swarmed by fist-sized spiders, hairless, lantern-flame inside their amber-tinted glass-like bodies
The spiders hated how the rats evaded their webs
Bottle fails to calm them down and instead scares them off with psychic images of fire
Bottle continues to climb to the bottom and a harness strap is lowered to him for the rest of the train to climb down

cards.h: Scene 52, 53, 54, 55 (Underneath Y’Ghatan, Koryk, Tarr, Deadsmell, Fiddler)

i.html: The crawling train panics when they stopped until word passed that Bottle found a shaft and needs rope
Koryk thinks of the Child Death Song, a Seti right of passage into adulthood that involved a grave log and being buried alive as a child in a coffin of the family crypt
Worms seem like a Seti metaphor for fear
Koryk yells at Cpl. Shard to check on Limp who stopped moving
Cpl. Shard was the one who knocked him out, twisted his leg to wake him up to prove it
The crawling train passed leather ropes and straps ahead
As Koryk gives the boy ahead of him the ropes
The boy listened to Koryk’s chanting, Koryk promises to teach him
Cpl. Tarr passes on the ropes and leathers
Balgrid wishes they were marching on the desert again, ‘If freedom was a god, Tarr…’
Cpl. Deadsmell exposes Sgt. Balm for panicking, screaming, and pissing himself
Sgt. Fiddler passes to Corabb rope that Smiles had dropped [again] in the temple, sticky with his blood
Corabb was determined not to leave Fiddler behind even if that means falling behind the train
Spending time with the Malazans, he realizes the lies behind the racism he’s held onto
Widdershins reminds Corabb he’s a prisoner, but Corabb doesn’t say anything to Fiddler
At the bottom of the shaft, Bottle found an arch opening and was surprised how the masonry was still able to withstand a three story tall building of stone after all this time
Bottle possessed the rat and sent it ahead
Inside the archway, hundreds of finely glazed ceramic. Bottle recognized the urns to be of the First Empire era. The iron screw caps had the same Jaghut symbol on Bottle’s grandmother’s ritual blade
Inside the urns were honey that still tasted fresh after thousands of years, he passed it to Cuttle and back to eat and salve their burn wounds
A few minutes later, they realized the honey had opioid effects like poppy
Bottle felt numb and hit his head against the stone floor, passing out
[Note: This was inspired by the “mad honey of Nepal”]
Corabb tied and strapped the unresponsive Fiddler’s body to his and climbed successfully down the vertical shaft even with body their body weights
At the bottom he found everyone asleep and applied the honey to his and Fiddler’s wounds
A blissful numbing sensation, Corabb recognized it as Carelbarra, the God Bringer
Morning, small fires still burn in the city

Keneb wakes and thinks about his wife Selv safe in her family estate in Quon Tali with their children, Kesen and Vaneb. Though they had drifted apart since two years before the rebellion and wouldn’t be surprised that she found a new lover by now
Bent the cattle-dog lies next to Keneb, Roach the lapdog digs in the sand
Grub runs up to Keneb asking what will come of the city, ‘she’ wants them to head westwards to find ships because of the plague [Note: from Ehrlitan]
Grub ominously says something is buried, neither Roach nor Keneb will see what that is
Two days and a night has passed since the Last Siege of Y’Ghatan
Fist Blistig was in charge of setting up the hospitals and organizing the Denul users, witches, and warlocks
31 more people succumbed to their wounds, but everyone else should recover
The Malaz 14th Army only has enough supplies for a week if they ration immediately
The plague from Ehrlitan has spread to Lothal, Admiral Nok’s fleet if forced to sail 9 more days to Sotka
Nil and Nether says the land spirits are pissed at them
Adjunct Tavore wants the 14th Army to start marching tonight
After Fist Blistig leaves, Adjunct Tavore asks Nether why Poliel has caused a plague
She snorted, Poliel’s the goddess of disease she don’t need no fucking reason lol
Pearl reported to Tavore that Leoman is still alive, the twins knew he went to the Queen of Dreams but have no answer why she saved him
Temul enters the tent, dragging Sinn inside who scratched his face
Sinn tried to go back inside Y’Ghatan
Adjunct Tavore tries to recruit her as High Mage, but Sinn ignores her
Adjunct Tavore won’t pursue Leoman, but knows as long as he lives Y’Ghatan will always be a failure and a curse to Empress Laseen and the Malazan Empire
When Nil says ‘Y’Ghatan will never rise again’, Tavore responds ‘the young know nothing of history’
Tavore leaves the tent
Nil and Nether discuss that Leoman will have a legacy of his victory over the Malazan Empire
‘The locals believe Coltaine ascended. The new Patron of crows -’ ‘Fools. Wickans do not descend. We just… reiterate.’

cards.h: Scene 60, 61, 62, 63 (South of Y’Ghatan, Lt. Pores, Faradan Sort, Keneb, Balm)

i.html: Cpt. Kindly wakes up the pore bastard that is Lt. Pores
Lt. Pores fingers on his left hand melted and fused, Cpt. Kindly thinks that’s not enough to take up a cot and puts him to work for the march tonight
Fist Tene Baralta lost an arm and isn’t complaining about it, because he’s still unconscious
Cpt. Faradan Sort ordered two Wickan women to wash Sinn and cut her hair short
Faradan Sort urgently tells Sinn to listen to what she has to say
Fist Keneb watches the Malaz 14th Army begin their march towards Sotka
Temul says they couldn’t find the deserters, Cpt. Faradan Sort and Sinn
Also, from now on the Wickans will not accept counter-orders from Malazan officers
Sgt. Balm has a fever dream of the Dal Honese gods, he was a former warlock
[Note: Balm was the death dirge guy]
Witch Eater Thesorma Raadil, wearing zebra skins, with four arms that wielded the four sacred weapons of the Dal Hon tribes: bola, kout, hook-scythe, and rock
She insinuates she doesn’t want to kill him, just to have her way with im
Imparala Ar, the Dung God, a large beetle defends Balm and wants the humans to dig to the Abyss
Brithan Troop, the eleven-headed vulture, crties out to leave him alone
Smiles dreams of her Itko Kan village, how there was a period with no fish that resulted in starvation, sacrificing her twin sister to the old spirits and the Elder God, Mael
The villagers forced her to ingest durhang oil, and tied her to the rock in the ocean for the waves to drown her and crabs to scavenge her dead body
Smiles ran away from home after that
Smiles threatens the spirits that she’ll drag them down to the demons of chaos if they try
Koryk dreams and remembers being raised by his Seti mother, who was disowned by her parents for having a half-Seti child at 14 years old
Koryk’s mother became a prostitute to take care of him, and he was raised among them
Full-blood Koryk’s that joined the army became Malazans, forgetting traditions
Like other outcast half-Seti, Koryk took the effort to keep to old Seti traditions
Crump dreams of being in the Mott swamp, with the Salamander god, Stump Flit, encouraging him to take his tail
Crump did something that made his siblings want to go after him
Crump relents and grabs the god’s tail, the salamander runs off shedding the tail and laughing
Corabb dreams he was in the desert, a girl he assumed as Sha’ik with burned eyes approached
Corabb begged her for no more holy wars, she whispers ‘Help me’
Fiddler dreams of standing in a landscape of mist
The ghost of Hedge tells him to wake up and lead [them] to the end, but doesn’t know what
Hedge hints the Bridgeburners didn’t cheat death, because Trotts and others aren’t with them
The ghosts of Y’Ghatan and thousands of years worth of memories died, a huge loss
Bottle dreams of laying on burnt grasslands
A dozen ape-like creatures were carving into a burnt body of a four-legged grass-eater
The pregnant Eres’al approached Bottle

Bottle was reminded of seeing a caged ape in Jakatakan, feeling sorrow for it, and hoping the scholar that purchased the ape had compassion and took him home to his tower on the Geni coast. Then releasing him into the wild where others apes accept it as their own
The Eres’al brushed her fingers across Bottle’s forehead, then slammed her fist downwards ending the dream
Bottle wakes up in the room full of Carelbarra honey
Cuttle is also awake, he dreamed of the mortal Treach being killed by K’Chain Che’Malle and ascending, sensing that the dying part was important
Bottle no longer feels any pain and moves to wake everyone else up
Bottle’s rat waited patiently and loyally, accepting his possessions
Sgt. Gesler dreamed of being the fire that barbaric shadowy figures were dancing and performing a ritual around
Gesler wakes up, everyone else was slowing waking to
Bottle continues his search for a way out, the tunnel gets narrower, a cornerstone of a building blocks the path, bisecting it so that only the children can fit
Behind the cornerstone was hole that had air currents pulled to the bottom of the pit
Bottle loses hope, but Cuttle demands his knife to cut his way through. There’s no turning back after the Temple of Scalissara collapsed on top of them
Smiles gave one of the children her throwing knife, thinking they'll be the inly ones who can survive because they can fit through the hole that the cornerstone was blocking
Thinks about Bottle was spineless, consorted with rodents and vermin, but surprised her by showing her kindness and carrying one if her double loads
The children passed through the cornerstone, crying and holding onto each other
When Bottle’s rat sensed that the air from the pit was warm, he realized sunlight is getting through
Bottle concludes the shaft and tunnels they’ve been using were carved by looters before them
Cuttle kicks the cornerstone, making it sink deeper but opening a hole revealing sunlight
One of the girls fell into the pit, possibly died
Bottle climbed and tried to hammer the opening wider
Cpt. Faradan Sort and Sinn had walked around a tel in Y’Ghatan twice, believing Sinn had a reason to run back to the city
Faradan Sort sees a girl that she assumed was a looter. Upon closer inspection she was dirty and bleeding as if from falling
Faradan Sort wanted to call it a day and tried to pull Sinn away from the wall, but Sinn held on tighter
Bottle dreams of an afterlife, wakes up when [Sinn] claws into his hand
Cpt. Faradan Sort realized Sinn was holding onto someone [Bottle]
Cpt. Faradan Sort takes her sword and tries to cut the opening bigger
Bottle alerts the train to get ready
Cuttle says the girl who fell found the looter’s tunnel, all of the children have escaped
[Note: Same girl that Faradan Sort thought was a looter]
Cpt. Faradan sort admits there was no search party, she and Sinn deserted to find survivors
Cuttle says Sinn might've known because her brother Cpl. Shard is alive and with them
Cpt. Faradan Sort also reveals she lost her Stormwall sword, burying it in an enemy
Bottle was able to escape through the hole and salutes her from the ground
Cpt. Faradan Sort knew who Bottle was the moment he carried Smiles second load
Cpt. Faradan Sort nearly stomps Bottle’s rat, Bottle rescues her and names her Y’Ghatan
Smiles overheard the conversation and says ‘All men are trash.’
The Malazans finally escape from the tunnels through a hole in a cliff wall
Cpl. Shard was holding a sleeping Sinn
Tulip was scratched up but resting to himself
Smiles was begrudgingly surrounded by children
Sgt. Gesler stared up at the sky
Bottle does roll call
Masan Gilani [Note: My ideal woman] is named for the first time
Bottle realizes Fiddler and Corabb are missing
Cpl. Tarr immediately runs back to the cliff wall, Sgt. Balm thinks the prisoner killed Fiddler
Corabb and Fiddler got left behind and was lost, Corabb spent a day dragging Fiddler determined not to leave him behind
Corabb feels that he had cast the chains of fanaticism off of him, feels as if he achieved freedom and understands Toblakai [Karsa]
Corabb apologizes to Fiddler that he has no more energy and is lost
Corabb lies that he dragged Fiddler so his squad wouldn't kill him. When Fiddler called him out, Corabb admits he just comply couldn't leave Fiddler behind
Corabb asks about Fiddler two names, Fiddler lets Corabb call him Fiddler
Sgt. Gesler came back to the tunnels to dig them out, understanding what Truth experienced when he sacrificed himself
Corabb continues to carry Sgt. Fiddler, Fiddler says he's never been in better hands

Ganoes Paran rides horseback, avoiding villages struck by Poliel’s plague
Thousands are going to die, Paran doesn't have a clue why
Paran thinks back to his residence in the Finnest House
Wishes Kruppe would've been the better Master of the Deck instead
Thought back to how Kruppe walked right past a dumbfounded Raest when the Jaghut opened the door
Kruppe arrives to tell Paran that Hood is at the center of things and that Paran must go to Seven Cities because the gods are at war
Gods cast shadows, does not elaborate what shadows cast
A crime and scheme would be put in motion by the time Paran arrives
Paran must arrive by any means necessary and must walk the singular shadow between life and death
Thinks about Apsalar, happy that she retains humanity in her
Ganath, a Jaghut, uses Omtose Phellack to defeat the T’lan Imass guarding her and break out of her barrow

Tall, gaunt, grey green skin, silver clasped harness holding knives, an iron mail baldric. Long black hair in a ponytail that reached her lower back. Tusked caps with blackened iron. Vertical pupils in amber eyes
Paran introduces himself in what Jaghut speech he learned from Raest. Ganath notes he sounds like an Imass or tuskless Jaghut
Paran assures Ganath there are no T’lan Imass nearby
Ganath broke out because she needs to fix a binding ritual imprisoning something that wants to conquer the world [Note: Dejim Nebrahl]
Paran is traveling south to talk with some people, Ganath travels with him because she wants a bath in the Raraku Sea
Apsalar, her horse, and the lizard skellies walk through villages that succumbed to Poliel’s plague
Swollen glands that block breathing, eating, drinking
The stomach bursts with no way to expel gas, stomach acids would burn the body from the inside
Fevers so high it cooks the brain
Eyes with mucus, ears that bled, flesh turning to jelly at the joints
Telorast and Curdle think Apsalar isn't affected by Poliel’s plague because she is blessed by Cotillion and Shadowthrone
There were signs in the village that something happened at Y’Ghatan, north west of here
Apsalar plans to travel via Shadow warren to Y’Ghatan and see what happened
Kalam, Quick Ben, and Stormy find a banquet with four chairs laid out before them, underneath a K’Chain sky keep
Food and wine came from all over Quon Tali
Don't know who set it up but no one's gonna turn down free food
Quick Ben asks about Stormy’s sword [Note: Legana Breed], Stormy said a T’lan Imass left to seal up a wound in the sky
Held a Tiste Andii head that was still alive when it went in
Stormy has a whole philosophy of don't think too much
Suggests if they can't kill their enemy, find someone else to do the dirty work for them
Quick Ben heard stories about a Malazan escort clashing with a fleet of Tiste Edur
The Silanda was commanded by Tiste Edur, with headless Tiste Andii rowing the oars
Quick Ben remembers finding a drowned Tiste Edur corpse by a river [Note: near Coral] on their way to fight the Pannion Domin
[Note: Memories of Ice Ch. 23 Scene 4]
Kalam thinks the Tiste Edur want their Shadow Realm back from Shadowthrone
Stormy says Kellanved and Dancer will always win because they don't fight fair
Kalam squints at the empty chair
All of the soldiers crawled and let the rat, Y’Ghatan, bite their fingers
The rat bit even Bottle, and snuggled at his feet
No one would start a fire in the camp, trauma
Sgt. Gesler went back in to help Corabb drag Sgt. Fiddler out
Fiddler should’ve died from the injuries, the carelbarra honey saved his life and was almost as potent as High Denul healing
Bottle was irritated Adjunct Tavore abandoned them even though it was the reasonable thing to do, and Cpt. Faradan Sort informed them of the eastern plague
Koryk says they're as good as dead and can walk away
Possible a god arranged the rat and everything for them to survive and make use of them
The fetishes Koryk wears are wards to make him invisible to gods, spirits, and demons
Smiles makes fun of Koryk and throws a knife at him

cards.h: Scene 5, 6, 7, 8, 9 (Y’Ghatan, Gesler, Balm, Hellian, Flashwit, Cuttle)

i.html: Cpt. Faradan Sort tells Sgt. Gesler that she felt guilty letting soldiers under her command get cut off, and that Sinn wasn't ‘addled’ when she pushed the fires back and returned to the city
No one can sleep because of the stars
Deadsmell thinks Sgt. Balm keeps talking on and on because he's glad his squad all made it out alive. Same with Sgt. Fiddler and Sgt. Hellian’s squads
Sgt. Hellian is tied up, jaw and teeth hurting from Cpl. Urb punching her unconscious, planning how she wants to kill Urb
Flashwit wishes she was smart like Bottle, Gesler, and Deadsmell
Mayfly says heavies don't need to be smart or think, they just get in the way
The soldiers can't sleep because they want to see the sun again
The sun starts to rise
Cuttle expresses his concerns to Sgt. Gesler, Sgt. Thom Tissy, and Sgt. Cord
The soldiers hate Adjunct Tavore for abandoning them
Also, that Bottle may have made a deal with the Queen of Dreams
Ganoes Paran and Ganath reach the Raraku Sea, rebirthed half a year ago
Paran makes camp, Ganath washes herself in the waters
Paran’s ritual begins
Ganath calls him a strange god, Paran denies it and says he's the Master of the Deck
Ganath explains he is an ascendant like the Errant or the Master of the Tiles of her time

Worshipped as a god by Imass, Barghast, and Trell, slaughtering innocents and offering their blood in the Errant’s name. The Errant defeated his followers and became neutral. His enemy was ennui and stagnation which is why the Forkrul Assail wanted to kill him and his followers
Ganath doesn't know if the Forkrul Assail were successful in killing the Errant
Paran’s ritual summoned all of Raraku’s dead. The skeletons and corpses appearing from the water holding weapons and standards from across of ages and eras
Human, Trell, Barghast, Imass, Jaghut
Paran then called out every name he studied of the Bridgeburners
Shank, Aimless, Runter, Detoran, Bucklund, Hedge, Mulch, Toes, Trotts, and more
Runter, who died at Black Coral, is the first to step forward. Next were Detoran, Sgt. Bucklund, and Hedge
Hedge makes jokes and says he already visited Fiddler who’s with the Malaz 14th Army (which Paran was unaware of) and how the Bridgeburners appeared to defeat Korbolo Dom’s Dogslayers
Paran says Raraku Sea is a gate, and he needs the Bridgeburners help to summon the Deragoth to defeat Dejim Nebrahl
Hedge knows six High Mages of the Nameless Ones sacrificed their blood and themselves to Dejim Nebrahl
The Bridgeburners are summoned by Ganoes Paran at the Raraku Sea, Hedge steps forward to answer his call
Taralack Veed nurses Icarium back to health and gaslights the hell out of him, pretending to be his companion
Taralack Veed wants them to travel northwest, to the coastline opposite of Sepik island. Veed disguised it as Icarium’s instinct
Taralack Veed talks about E’napatha N’apur, and how Icarium slayed every its tyrant and every man, woman, and child so evil city would be forgotten
Icarium is horrified
Veed continues to explain the Icarium’s enemy is evil, and thus the world is Icarium’s enemy
Icarium trusts Veed
Heboric feels torn between being Treach’s Destriant while ghosts accuse him of not being worthy. At the same time voices from an alien sea of jade prayed for his return
Scillara complains of pregnancy and aches, noticed Heboric’s ghost hands glowing particularly green
Heboric says the dead city E’napatha N’apur is ahead of them, revealed after thousands of years being buried
Described how the king closed the city to Icarium, a soldier shot a warning arrow that ricocheted off a rock and into Icarium’s companions throat, resulting in Icarium killing the whole city
Heboric can see the ghosts of the city, a memory of farming communities. Some ghosts know they're dead, others live in ignorance or want to keep their illusion
The ghost soldiers call put to Heboric believing him as a follower of the Seven (that would eventually become the Holy Falah’d)
Does not see Heboric as a worshiper of a First Hero like Treach, Ryllandaras, Rikkter, Tholen, or Denesmet
Heboric complains he is nobody to them but the voices won't leave him alone

Scillara laughs, musing that all gods might be thousands of different faces on the same god. How there’s so many different paths, beliefs, tribes, and armies fighting each other not knowing or realizing they all might be worshiping the same god
Greyfrog swallowed a goat still kicking in his belly
Greyfrog stands on a cliff watching the group
Scillara is a child swollen beauty miserable with ached and discomfort
[Note: Why isn't he talking to her? Doesn't seem to bear ill will]
Felisin Younger is scared and alone, but likely to reject Greyfrog’s attention
Crokus is impatient
Heboric is haunted
Samar Dev and Karsa Orlong traveled past dry scrublands, to plains, arriving at a deciduous forest with a boreal forest ahead of them
Samar Dev was fascinated by fringe tribes of bhederin hunters, a primitive lifestyle unchanged for thousands of years
Their wolf dogs had their canines removed
Iron weapons suggested they traded, woven baskets instead of clay pots suggested they were nomadic
Lone trees on empty plains, adorned with fetishes, antlers, and skulls suggested they were sites of worship and cemetery grounds
Just as Samar Dev was thinking how Karsa Orlong was surprisingly an easy travel partner, he wanted her to distract and separate a female bhederin cause he's tired of deer and rabbit meat
Samar Dev refuses, Karsa states ‘Witness’ and rides off with Havok to slay a bull and cow without her help
Samar Dev notices one of the tribe hunters witnessed Karsa’s hunt, Samar Dev thinks she's going to end up dead and wonders how many of Karsa’s past traveling companions felt the same
Dejim Nebrahl was watching a caravan of child traffickers from the shade
He was recovering after Mappo had killed two of his seven bodies
The caravan might have enough flesh and blood for Dejim Nebrahl to recover his two bodies, possibly enough to spawn an eighth
Turns out Dejim Nebrahl has a sense of morality and justice, instilled in him by the First Emperor who planned Dejim Nebrahl to be the guardian of the First Empire
Chapter 9 Scene 6, 7 (Raraku Sea, Iskaral Pust,
Mogora)
Iskaral Pust rides his mule to the Raraku Sea and releases the first fish to its waters
He then messes with his mule, disappearing into the Shadow warren
Mogora appears, kicks in a cask of sharks, then hops into her own Shadow warren
Iskaral Pust folded shadow upon shadow, swiftly traveling across the continent until he encountered Dejim Nebrahl
Dejim Nebrahl itself entered the Shadow warren to attack Iskaral Pust in a reverse V formation with two t'rohlbarahl flanking and three in the center
Iskaral Pust galloped on his mule, then halted to a complete stop sending Iskaral somersaulting through the air and landing flat on his back
The center t'rohlbarahl pounced on Iskaral but he disappeared
Iskaral appears at their side and unleashed ‘Shadow-wrought power’ that cracked like lighting, tossing their bodies in the air in mists of blood
The flanking t'rohlbarahl attacked, but instead Iskaral blinks away again and they crash into eachother
Iskaral appears again and catches all five t'rohlbarahl in a wave of sorcery that popped gravel and sand into the air in spear-like geysers
Dejim Nebrahl flees the Shadow warren in a panic
Iskaral Pust is indignant it dared to challenge him, continues on with his travel
Dejim Nebrahl wasn't even Iskaral’s goal, just an obstacle
Iskaral Pust arrives at a fissure. A t'rohlbarahl carcass was cleaned by scavenger animals
Climbing down, Iskaral finds Mappo and plans to use his mule to help him out
One more day unattended and Mappo Runt would've died
Two compound fractured in his left arm
Large flap of back skin blackened with rot that Mappo cut off and tossed into the fissure
Back infested with maggots
Crushed ribs
Iskaral was about to apply medicine he think is High Denul, Mogora appears and stops him from applying what is actually a vial of paralt spider venom
Mogora prepares actual healing supplies, and is surprised to see mule, someone, expertly erected tent and had a steaming cauldron of water by a tripod over a stone ringed campfire
Iskaral was unable to understand Mogora’s ritual chanting which he refers as Woman’s Language
Iskaral explains there was also a Man’s Language which is actually gibberish and sole purpose was to confound women
Mogora sets up a ring of stones around Mappo, crab-walking and pisses on all of them counterclockwise
She then stands over Mappo and pulls out seven strands of grey hair and lifted them to the cloud of black spiders that completely covered the sky
Thousands of spiders wrapped around Mappo in a web cocoon
Mogora dispersed the spiders, revealing a full moon that appeared much closer to the planet, almost within an arm’s reach
Iskaral Pust is confounded and walks away to the tent
Lostara Yil wakes up on an altar of a Shadow temple a league and a half away from Y’Ghatan
T’riss Queen of Dreams had set the precedent of intervening, thus Cotillion chose to save Lostara Yil
The moon appeared to be plunging from the sky, even Cotillion doesn't know why
[Note: Moon detail #1, Mogora’s magic to heal Mappo]
Cotillion wants Lostara Yil to consider either being loyal to Adjunct Tavore or to Empress Laseen
Cotillion considers saving Lostara Yil as paying a debt he owed her by watching her Shadow Dance so long ago
Cotillion appears at Iskaral Pust’s camp
The moon was back in its place, Mogora didn't actually move it but drawn its power away
Cotillion recognized Mogora as ‘one of Ardata’s’ and she veers into her spider form, fleeing
Cotillion also departs via Shadow
Kalam, Quick Ben, and Stormy return from the imperial warren to find Y’Ghatan burned
A river of fused metal and glass flowed from Crump’s crater
Quick Ben immediately suspects olive oil and wonders if they stockpiled the harvest only to burn it
A massive ground mound is seen, a separate mound is dug for the enemy
The group decide to circle around the city before returning to the Malaz 14th Army
Apsalar arrived at Y’Ghatan and was approached by Kalam, Quick Ben, and Stormy
Telorast and Curdle run to hide

Apsalar senses Hood’s aura around Quick Ben, Cotillion’s presence meeting with Kalam recently, and Stormy’s spirit bound to a T’lan Imass [Note: Legana Breed] and the Fire of Life that the T’lan Imass worship
Wonders why Death, Shadow, and Fire are working together during this war between the gods
Kalam is angry that Quick Ben had been hiding his involvement with Hood
Quick Ben has been trying to make up the rules as he goes and get answers from both sides, stressed and stretching his limits
Stormy draws the T’lan Imass sword ready to attack Quick Ben, Kalam stops him
Apsalar announces she’s going to join their group
Quick Ben senses Telorast and Curdle, Apsalar just says ignore them
Their objective coincides with Cotillion’s final assassination target
Cpt. Faradan Sort promoted Cpl. Urb to sergeant, so Sgt. Hellian has to decide who the next corporal will be
Tavos Pond (mage), Balgrid (fat mage), Maybe (sapper), and Lutes (healer) are now a part of Sgt. Hellian’s squad
Touchy and Brethless argue, Hellian threatens to cut herself to shut them up
Eventually she promotes both of them to corporal
Sgt. Hellian’s squad gossip amongst themselves
Touchy and Brethless talk about the Kartool temple incident and wants to keep Hellian drunk
Maybe thinks Hellian is actually a good leader considering her actions in Y’Ghatan, doesn't convince the twins
Sgt. Gesler muses on the heavies that Cpt. Faradan Sort order to join his squad
Mayfly, Uru Hela (Korelri), Flashwit (Napan), Shortnose
The soldiers are all unarmored and weaponless, need to catch up to the Malaz 14th Army before raiders find them
Also thinks about how so many Malazans died for fanatics who were going to end up killing themselves one way or another, making everything feel pointless
Bottle decides to take rat Y’Ghatan with them on the march, and her baby rats
Koryk walks to old clay pits where bodies of Y’Ghatan residents were dumped to collect their bones and replace the ones the Malaz 14th Army lost in Y’Ghatan
*** Bones of the Malaz 14th Army

In Aren, when Adjunct Tavore was assembling the Malaz 14th Army to march on Sha’ik, Grub was found next to her holding a femur bone from one of the graveyards. The omen meant that Tavore was a child marching them to their deaths. Fist Gamet and Adjunct Tavore considered dissolving the army before they even started, waiting another year to build a new one. Fiddler convinces the army to embrace the omen, rather than fight it, by raiding the Aren cemetery and tying bones to their uniforms. Adjunct Tavore saw a fingerbone necklace on Keneb and orders everyone to do the same.
Sgt. Fiddler looked over his squad then shaved his beard
One of the Y’Ghatan children attached herself to Fiddler and followed him every now and then, Fiddler said he's gonna toss her in a river to wash her
Apsalar, Kalam, Quick Ben, and Stormy arrive
Half of old Sgt. Whiskeyjack’s squad reunites
Apsalar explains she split up with Crokus who goes by Cutter now
Stormy is upset that Truth died and walks off to the Malazan camp, Gesler following
Fiddler wants Quick Ben to meet Bottle
The Malaz 2nd Army High Fist Dujek Onearm
Cpt. Ganoes Paran
9th Squad
Sgt., Whiskeyjack
Cpl. Kalam Mekhar
Quick Ben, mage
Sorry/Apsalar, marine
Hedge, sapper
Fiddler, sapper
Trotts, marine
Mallet, healer
Ganoes Paran, Ganath, and ghost Hedge arrive at a wide blackstone bridge in a half-birthed, stillborn realm. Grey mists above and below
Verdith’anath, the Bridge of Death. The Jaghut myth of what the underworld looks like. Older than even the Holds
[Note: They were at the Raraku Sea before this. No explanation how they got here]
Paran had seen this bridge in his visions that might push him forward in his goal
The bridge was beneath Hood’s realm, Hood has no dominance over this land or its inhabitants
Ganath says Paran’s otataral sword is useless here
Paran doesn't mind he kept it in Coll’s estate most of the time anyways
The iron and bronze scabbard negates most of its effects
[Note: Actually, Erikson forgot Ganoes even had Adjunct Lorn’s otataral sword in Memories of Ice]
Paran tosses a small spoked, circular object and summons the Trygalle Trade Guild
Karpolan Demesand, two Pardu (that Apsalar beat up in Ehrlitan), and other shareholders
Karpolan offers wine made from bik’trara, ice flowers across a Jaghut glacier
Karpolan’s presence makes ghost Hedge temporarily corporeal enough to enjoy the wine
Hedge ponders on his existence as a ghost, feeling like his soul had nowhere to go
Found himself with the other dead Bridgeburners
After the campaigns in Raraku, Black Dog, etc. a Bridgeburner becomes either a very humble person or a straight bastard who thinks everyone including the Empress worships them
Hedge is not friends with the latter half of the Bridgeburners
Hedge wonders what's in it for them, whose next task is this long march. What is ascendancy?
Paran tries to give his best theory on what ascendancy is
Ascendants are beings who can become gods if they obtain worshippers. Ascendants are Unaligned
Gods who lost their worshippers are emasculated until their faith is renewed
Elder Gods needs blood spilled on hallowed ground
Primitive spirits just need to have their name remembered
Ascendants have superhuman strength and superhuman will whose actions ripple through everything
First Hero was a title that basically meant ascendant
Treach would've eventually lost his ascendancy and be a mindless soletaken tiger for the rest of his life
However, Fener died and Treach was killed in unusual circumstances that led to his godhood
By looking at history and trends, ascendancy is an inevitable phenomenon
In any group of people, enough pressure will build for someone to become an ascendant, then gain worshipers and become a god
Ghost Hedge wonders if Paran is going to make a new card for the ascended Bridgeburners
Paran will think about it. Does not believe the Bridgeburners are being directly manipulated
Feels that the Bridgeburners is being called upon by a force of nature to reassert a long lost law, eventually
Hedge and Paran don't know what the ascended Bridgeburners are marching toward

cards.h: *** Treach/Track, the Tiger of Summer and War

i.html: Hairlock had thrown Toc the Younger into the Warrens of Chaos where he wandered and had come across Togg, the Wolf of Winter who inhabited Toc’s body because they both have one eye
Toc was traveling on the Lamatath Plain with Lady Envy, Onos T’oolan, the Seguleh, Garath (dog), and Baaljagg (an ay wolf that carried Fanderay, the She-Wolf of Winter)
It was at this time that through Togg, he received visions of Treach who was nearby
Treach was a First Hero that became a Soletaken tiger from the Beast Ritual in the First Empire
When the T’lan Imass slaughtered the First Empire, the First Heroes that survived was Treach (tiger), his brother Ryllandaras (jackals at the time), and Messremb (bear)
Over thousands of years, Treach became insane and was locked in his tiger form
Treach got fucked up by four undead K’Chain Che’Malle until Tool’s sister, Kilava Onass who rejected the Tellann Ritual, came and destroyed the K’Chain Che’Malle with ‘black water’ sorcery
While Treach lay dying, his memories and sanity returned an asked that he be killed
Instead, Kilava Onass tells him that the most ancient Elder God [K’rul] has become active once again and needs a god of war, which Treach was selected for
Once Treach died, he ascended and became Trake, the new god of war
This may have occurred around the same time that Baudin put Heboric’s stump on his Fener tattoos which pulled Fener, the Boar of War, into the mortal world making Fener vulnerable
Treach had chosen Heboric as his Destriant
Suddenly, ochre-skinned creatures with long armed claws and short ape legs climb up from beneath the bridge and attack
Paran hack and slashed from his horse, falling behind the carriage as he went to pick up a shareholder that was pulled off
Paran rushes through about 50 of the creatures to catch up to the carriage
One of the near dead shareholders, Stebar, lets himself fall off so he could get a ‘spike’ which doubles his value which goes to his wife back home
Paran asks how Hedge knew about this place, Hedge doesn't he only went to where Paran described
[Note: Yeah Erikson cryptic, there's no explanation here]
About a third of a league ahead, they encounter a carriage of Trade Mistress Darpareth Vayd who went missing two years ago
Mistress Vayd was contracted by Sedara Orr, niece of Turban Orr. The mission was to observe and report what they found in this realm.

[Note: Turban Orr was on the Darujhistan Council that tried to push for the city to be neutral towards the Malazan threat, with ambitions of becoming a High Fist. Rallick Nom killed the councilman that would’ve won Turban Orr’s proposition, and later killed Orr at Gedderone’s Fete]
Paran recognized Vayd was attacked by the two Hounds of Shadow that he released from Dragnipur
Doan and Ganrod
Ganoes Paran blamed Adjunct Lorn for Tattersail’s death (when Bellurdan Skullcrusher killed her)
Hairlock ambushes Paran on his way to Lorn, Quick Ben calls on Cotillion to send the Hounds to destroy Hairlock and rescue Paran
Paran and the Hounds get into a fight, Anomander Rake descends from the sky to fight the Hounds alongside Paran to eliminate Shadow’s interference in his war against the Malazans
After Rake kills two Hounds, he leaves. Paran touches the Hound’s blood and gets transported into Dragnipur
After speaking with another prisoner who says the Hounds are disrupting the peace, Paran summons the male twin of Oponn and threatens him to free the Hounds
Paran tricks the Hounds into a gate that leads to Kurald Galain, the Elder Warren of Darkness

Somehow after going into Kurald Galain (Elder Warren of Darkness), the Hounds of Shadow Doan and Ganrod traveled to enter the Nascent (a fragment of Kurald Emurlahn, the warren of Shadow) so that they could reunite with the Deragoth, the Hounds of Darkness
In other words, Shadow Doggies → Darkness warren. Later,Shadow Doggies → Shadow warren to find Darkness Doggies.
Yes this is all confusing af.
After a league, the bridge ended at a moss covered gateway. On the other side was silty waters which Paran didn't expect to be there
[Note: Never explicitly stated, but pretty much the Nascent where Trull and Onrack freed two of the Deragoth]
A large wail is heard in the distance
Two days after leaving E'napatha N’apur
Heboric has been reaching out to the lost souls in the shattered sea of jade, the souls see him as their god
Heboric looked over the dead city they past and thought abominations like Icarium should be killed
Fener has been dragged into mortal realm, losing most of his power, and disappeared hiding from hunters
Heboric feels he needs to find a way to send Fener back, possibly share the Throne of War with the Wolf
Heboric realizes Fener would've been better off if he left him alone
Scillara complains of her pregnancy
Scillara rides up to Crokus and explains how Heboric has been taking them through old dead roads, the lands around them was farmlands of civilization’s past
Scillara thinks Bidithal’s cult was genius to take advantage of people who’ve had power and possessions taken from them from the Malazan Empire
Heboric explains that the idea of the cults actually belong to the Crippled God
The Crippled God was a broken creature who had the promise of something better
A dream of a paradise where you can get rid of your natural excesses and depravities
To obtain it you needed to die
Heboric and other historian’s see the Crippled God’s paradise as a lie, because absolution is not free. The idea itself would invite anarchy and say everything they do is pointless
Iskaral Pust dreams of fishing, Mogora calls him an idiot, Mappo rouses in his sleep
Mappo Runt finds himself in a dream on Jacuruku, surrounded by pillars and a cloudy sky with a hole in it. Four to five years after the fall of the Crippled God
[Note: I THINK these are the Dolmens of Tien from the ICE novels, but no way to confirm]
Ardata appears, a young woman with long hair the color of dying flames, eyes of beaten gold, and black silks
A queen driven from her home [Note: Queen of Spiders]
Ardata was good at hiding, says Mogora would rue this day
Reveals the Nameless Ones had been manipulating Icarium since he was young, forging him into a weapon with each partner given to him. Mappo had been discarded for yet another guardian
Ardata is upset that Shadowthrone correctly assumed her allegiance with him and living up to his expectations
Shadowthrone wants to help Mappo to defeat the Nameless Ones
Mappo wakes up to Iskaral Pust and Mogora bloody and fighting each other
The wailing creature across the bridge is a large, scaled, bear like creature with a flat head and one eye
[Note: Is this a fucking random encounter? This monster shows up nowhere else lmao]
Paran tells the carriage to ride towards a hill, he uses a wooden card and chants words to capture the beast inside it
On top of the hill, they could see five Deragoth statues, two have been freed
Paran guesses Doan and Ganrod found their Deragoth counterparts and reunited with them
Hedge reveals Toblakai had slaughtered the two freed Deragoth at the Battle of Raraku
Despite the Deragoth existing long before First Emperor Dessimbelackis, he found the last remaining seven and split his soul among them and an attempt at godhood
The Deragoth had domesticated the Eres'al, ancestor to imass and humans
At the base of the freed Deragoth statues was a temple made of driftwood.
Footprints of people with really wide feet
Paran and Ganath, who casts a light cantrip to explore inside
They found the bodies of Trade Mistress Darpareth Vayd and Sedara Orr were found bound and spreadeagled, used in a elder ritual of spilling blood
Paran plans Hedge to use munitions to free the remaining five Deragoth
Hedge brings up that the Deragoth might immediately seek to reunite with their Hounds of Shadow counterparts in the Shadow warren which Paran didn't think of
Paran uses a House Shadow card to call Shadowthrone and let him know that he's going to free the Deragoth and will chase the Hounds of Shadow wherever they are
Shadowthrone has five grievances
The Nameless ‘Idiots’ release Dejim Nebrahl and used him to get rid of [Mappo]
Paran wants to use the Deragoth to get rid of Dejim Nebrahl
Toblakai [Karsa] had slain two Deragoth already and may be nearby to slaughter the rest
Now Paran wants Shadowthrone to send the Hounds of Shadow to Seven Cities so the Deragoth won't wreak havoc on the Shadow realm
Paran assumes by a faint scream of frustration that Shadowthrone might've accepted his plan
The distance between the Deragoth statues were too great for Hedge’s detonation timers
Hedge argued to leave him behind since he's just a ghost
They compromise to wait as long as they can for Hedge
Karpolan Demesand said with each expedition, the Trygalle Trade Guild are able to expand their maps with every realm they visit. Confident they'll return home
Hedge detonates, the five Deragoth are released and Paran is forced to leave Hedge behind since he can't be seen
The TTG carriage travels via warren to a realm where tens of thousands of undead, forgotten by Hood, fill the vista and claw at them, begging to bring them along
Ganath transports them to Omtose Phellack onto a glacier down a snowy mountainside
The carriage overturns as it falls down the slope, several shareholders are injured and killed
Hedge comes out from his hiding spot, the Trygalle Trade Guild and Deragoth are gone
Hedge believes he has to earn his own absolution, thus wanders the Nascent
Scillara remembers her mother being a prostitute for the Ashok Regiment and died when she left
Became apart of Bidithal’s cult, where suffering would lead to paradise after death, which the Crippled God supported
A faith with a seductive promise whose central tenet was unprovable
The group reach a marshland that died during nesting season and became a dried out basin
Heboric suffers thinking about being Treach’s Destriant as the group rode past the basin, to the shoreline with abandoned docks
Following the old road a third of a league into an old hamlet
Suddenly T’lan Imass attacks them
Scillara’s horse is impaled, knocking her to the ground. A T’lan Imass pierces through her chest, swarms of flies squeeze into her wound
Crokus’ horse is decapitated and his belly is cut open, his bowels falling out into his hands
Greyfrog’s limbs are all cut off
Heboric is knocked down and repeatedly stabbed over and over
Heboric laments how useless he was to everyone he met and how Fener and Baudin were better off without him
Book Three:
Shadows of the King
Samar Dev and Karsa Orlong are approached by Boatfinder and the Anibar tribe, as Karsa was butchering and skinning a bhederin
‘Revenants’ have sailed in great ships and attacked the tribe about 20 times with warriors and shamans that can cast sorcery
Boatfinder wishes to trade a penis bone in exchange for Karsa to stop them
The Anibar remind Karsa of his cowardly Uryd tribe, thus he is determined to drag the Anibar along to witness him slaughter the revenants and for them to find courage
Boatfinder sends some Anibar to help with the bhederin
Boatfinder tells Samar Dev of the Iron King Iskar Jarak and his prophecy
When the Ugari (Ugarat) fled westwards from the Mezla (derogatory word for Malazans) attack
The Anibar had given them refuge, but the Malazans found and killed all of the Ugari
King Iskar Jarak, a Malazan, told the Anibar they would not attack them but others would not spare them
He prophesied that wielders of birth-stone would save the Anibar at their time of greatest peril
Boatfinder takes them through very old paths the Anibar used, marked by stones set in the shapes of snakes and turtles depending on the rise and fall of the water level
Samar Dev realizes when Boatfinder speaks, the frozen time means the past. The flowing time means the present. The unfound time means the future
Samar Dev asks if there is a bridge that connects the past to the present, and they cannot cross it because it is burning
A very weird out of nowhere metaphor that suggests King Iskar Jarak was a Bridgeburner
Taralack Veed and Icarium travel along the coast
Icarium is suspicious of Taralack Veed
Taralack Veed rehearses to Icarium speeches that the Nameless Ones gave him
How Icarium destroyed an Azath House to free his father [Gothos, Tremorlor], a person who actually volunteered to be an Azath guardian
Destroying the House released demonic entities that escaped around the world
The incident damaged Icarium’s memory
A cult of the Nameless Ones was founded to appoint guardians for Icarium to guide his fury, assert a moral focus, and be his friend
Icarium’s justice is There is an enemy only Icarium can defeat
Icarium weeps, Taralack Veed’s gaslighting is effective
Taralack Veed foresees a long march, but Icarium says the ‘sea is filled with ships’
Months have passed since the T’lan Imass visited Barathol Mekhar’s village in the prologue
The villagers come across Crokus’ group nearly dead by the T’lan Imass attack and try to save them despite Barathol feeling it's too late
Heboric was chopped to pieces, possibly the target
Felisin Younger was not among them
L’oric arrives, saying Felisin Younger was supposed to be for the Queen of Dreams
He was also sad that his companion, Greyfrog, is also dead
Recognizes Barathol is a soldier
The Semk woman was a healer in Hissar’s Holy Army
Scillara gives birth to a Napan baby
Tries to best to clean Crokus’ intestines
Barathol pulled out old Kulat’s stash from behind the bar, everyone drinks
L’oric used Denul to clean and seal Crokus’ and Scillara's wound
Wonders why he didn't feel pain when Greyfrog died, their connection should've been severed
Believes the T’lan Imass were the Unbound had attacked Treach’s Destriant and kidnapped the Queen of Dream’s chosen one
[Note: The Unbound were the seven renegade T’lan Imass that were also the Seven Faces in the Rock gods of the Teblor and servants of the Crippled God]
T’lan Imass that slaughtered Aren
Barathol clarifies the T’lan Imass didn't need gates, he opened his gate after the slaughter started and left. Killed everyone who chased him
Aren and Seven Cities rebelled in Barathol’s name
Barathol thought the T’lan Imass came for him

[Note: The Aren Rebellion happened under Emperor Kellanved’s rule, instigated by Surly. A Fist was murdered by a Red Blade officer [Barathol] and the people rose up against the Malazan garrison and drive the Red Blades out of the city. Barathol threw open a gate to escape while the Logros T’lan Imass put down the rebellion]
The Unbound T’lan Imass brings Felisin Younger to a buried city that Kulat, a seneschal of the Crippled God, has prepared for her
[Note: Kulat was from Barathol’s village]
The Apocalypse is devastation. They must die inside to kill all that lies outside. Only death is where people find salvation
Whispers, crippled disorders that give the cultists their strength
Kulat proclaims Felisin as Sha’ik Reborn, the Chosen Hand of the Apocalypse
The Hounds of Shadow and Cotillion visits Iskaral Pust and Mappo
Cotillion is impressed Iskaral Pust defeated Dejim Nebrahl, didn't even know he was that powerful
Cotillion is reminded that Icarium nearly destroyed the Azath House, Tremorlor, when the Hounds helped him
Reveals that when Icarium first destroyed an Azath House [to free his father], Icarium was infected by a ‘parasite’ of chaos that was enemy to progression, thought, spirit, and life
Emperor Kellanved and Dancer was absent from the Malazan Empire for many years because they were mapping out the Azath Houses and master its power
Became gods because they needed more than one lifetime to achieve their goal
The Azath Houses are repositories for Lost Elementals
[Note: This sounds like such an important foundational worldbuilding detail, but it never gets mentioned again lmao]
Scholars acknowledge water, fire, earth, and air
There are others that the Azath Houses draw immense power from
Life, death, dark, light, shadow, time, past, present, future, desire, deed, sound, silence, faith, denial
Unclear is some elements should be subsets of another
The purpose of elements is to give shape and meaning to all that surrounds us externally, and guide us internally. Concepts is all that's needed
The Azath Houses are failing, Shadowthrone and Cotillion are competing against the Nameless Ones
The Nameless Ones are desperate and want to push the Azath toward chaos and dissolution
Mappo is willing to work with Shadowthrone and Cotillion to save Icarium
Cotillion just tells Mappo to keep doing what he's doing
A 「C O N V E R G E N C E」 of a vast magnitude is coming that Cotillion feels helpless against
Cotillion leaves
Mappo asks if Iskaral Pust is joining his journey, Iskaral Pust rejects
Ganath transports Paran and the Trygalle Trade Guild to a valley west of Raraku’s Sea
