Quick Ben scoots in more to make room for Kalam, Kalam joins him
The Malazan Imperial Fleet arrived at Sepik’s crescent bay 4-5 days earlier than expected because of the gale winds
[Note: They're taking the long route around Seven Cities to return to Quon Tali, to avoid a plague that has already ended]
Admiral Nok’s two lead dromons quickly turn around as thousands of gulls, crows, and vultures exploded into the sky above the city
The Tiste Edur had slaughtered Sepik
Adjunct Tavore and Apsalar both knew it was the Tiste Edur, a people cruel enough to enslave their own remnant people
They both know that the Tiste Edur are not chasing the Malazans, they're going home
Neither would say how they got that information
Adjunct Tavore says they'll resupply in Nemil and orders Apsalar to find Quick Ben
Apsalar already knows he's hiding among the crates below
Fist Keneb asks Apsalar how she has info
Nether answers that a god comes to break her heart again and again, Nil teases Nether is lusting after someone
Keneb apologizes
In Sgt. Fiddler’s squad, Cuttle points out that since Sepik is a Malazan imperial principality, the Tiste Edur attack was an act of war
The squad thinks they can crush the Tiste Edur if they follow them home to the Malazan Empire, especially with Quick Ben
Bottle explains Quick Ben only wanted an illusion, the Eres'al made it real and he doesn't want an actual war using Holds
Bottle is concerned why the Eres'al is pushing the Malazans so fast through Mael’s realm
[Note: Might explain the ‘argument’ between Eres'al and Mael that Spite was talking about]
High Fist Ganoes Paran leads the Malaz 5th Army northeast
Ganoes and Noto Boil have a silly conversation
Noto Boil started out in Kartool, being paid to break dog legs for D’rek’s barbaric festival
Small tangent about adolescent boys’ lustful fantasies about goddess statues like Soliel
After the Malazan Empire outlawed the festival, Noto Boil became a healer in the Theftian campaigns of Korel
Noto Boil was an apprentice healer to Ipshank and friend to Manask, both people loyal to the legendary Malazan commander, Greymane
Noto Boil was the sent to be a healer to a full legion in Genabackis
Outrider Hurlochel reports to Ganoes that a group of unidentified riders have joined pilgrims 4-5 days ahead of them
Fist Rythe Bude tells Cpt. Sweetcreek to stop complaining about High Fist Paran
Feels that Dujek’d confidence in Paran is enough for the rest of the Fists to follow him too
They pass by burial mounds of pilgrims that died along the way, one had a staff with crow feathers, Coltaine worshipers
Cpl. Futhgar points out to the eastern sky, a string of suns curved like a longbow. Two of them had tails like a comet. A misshapen, blurred moon is above it
Noto Boil says the sky is falling, the same way that meteors have destroyed the Korel continent
Ganoes orders to send Noto Boil ahead, find Hurlochel, and halt the army to find cover
Ganoes wishes he paid more attention to the moon, possibly the war of the gods, and goes to find Ormulogun to get his Deck of Dragons
The string of suns with green halos were above Mappo’s boat, Otataral Island is east of them
Iskaral Pust begged Mogora for sex and Shadowthrone to come save him
Spite said to go after ‘them’ and veers into her dragon form
The string of suns turned into spears of green fire plunging toward them
The Malazan Imperial Fleet are a continent away, sees the string of suns as covering a third of the horizon
Sgt. Fiddler asks Bottle if this is another Crippled God
The resupply with Nemil is cancelled as their ships try to flee the suns instead
Bottle thinks the shockwave from suns will be enough to kill everyone, even at this distance
[Note: It seems like the Eres’al were pushing the Malazans fast to get away from the suns]
Sgt. Hellian is drunk off Nemil brandy as everyone else is panicking
Runs into Admiral Nok who tries the brandy and gives her his flask that has the Imperial scepter and sigils for Cartheron Crust, Urko Crust, and two others
Admiral Nok helps guide her below decks, she sticks her tongue out at people to keep the flask to herself
Ganoes runs to Ormulogun, Ormulogun trips and falls, the Deck of Dragon cards fall out and most of them are empty
Ormulogun cried that Ganoes wanted perfection, so he barely made any progress
Ganoes drew in the sand, trying to summon Mael
Ormulogan picks up a random card, screams in Ganoes’ ear, and Ganoes ends up summoning Hood instead
‘a gate, a mass of twisted bones and pale, bruised flesh, dangling strands of hair, innumerable staring eyes, and beyond it was grey, murky oblivion’
‘black-cowled, tall. This is the hoary old bastard himself’
Ganoes makes a bargain with Hood for his help
One face grew animate, its eyes widened. Neither Ganoes nor Hood notices the face as Hood tells him the price
The bargain is accepted, Hood opens the gate from this side
Firestones hailed upon Crokus’ boat, burning holes into the wood and sails
Chaur grabbed Heboric’s corpse and sinks into the ocean, as the boat itself sinks further
Chaur feels Heboric’s corpse move within the wrapped fabric as he drowns and loses consciousness
Geysers shot up where firestones struck the ocean
Barathol dived after Chaur, Crokus grabbed Scillara who was glad she left her baby behind
The dragon [Spite] appeared above them as the Sanal’s Grief was destroyed, Crokus and Scillara are in the water
Heboric hears the millions of voices in the jade giants
He remembers that Treach had to die first before he could ascend
Heboric realizes he is not the Destriant, the mortal representative. Instead he is the Shield Anvil, the mortal repository that assumes the sorrow of the world
Heboric stated Hood sent him back, rejected him, flung him back. This is the result of Ganoes’ bargain with Hood
Heboric calls out to the voices to reach for his hands, hands cut loose to do what he can't
Barathol dives deep and sees Chaur drowning as Heboric’s corpse glow with green light and heat
Crokus floated on driftwood and saw that the firestones were the size of sand, their green light turned red in the water
Scillara points over to Otataral Island that was now covered in a glowing jade dome with dozens of colossal jade arms like Heboric’s reach skyward
The suns fell onto the dome one by one, each causing a drum beat sound with shockwaves resonating to shake the waters around Crokus
[Spite] grabs Crokus and Scillara in her talons
Heboric tells the millions of souls to never mind the pain and wait with him in darkness
He and Baudin couldn't have imagined this would happen when he touched the statue
As Shield Anvil, Heboric realizes one cannot in any real measure, remember pain
Mappo watches Spite, full of scorch marks, drop Crokus and Scillara on the boat, Scillara wakes first
Mappo believes Iskaral’s indifferent mule is the reason why none of the firestones harm their ship
Barathol climbs over the side with Chaur, yells his name for him to do his chores until he wakes, they both weep in each other’s arms
Mappo senses Spite push away her pain, so that she would not ruin everyone else’s joy of surviving together
Meanwhile, Mogora sweep kicks Iskaral Pust onto his butt and disappears into spiders
Crokus wakes up and asks about Heboric
Both Barathol and Mappo tell him he got his corpse close enough, and that was the reason why they are saved
Crokus asks about Icarium, and is sorry that he lost Icarium
They weep together
Spite sees Mappo cry because he feels it's his fault for losing Icarium, meanwhile she was the one that participated in releasing Dejim Nebrahl to attack and separate Mappo and Icarium
She hopes Icarium meets her sister, Lady Envy [Note: and kills her, spiteful lady]
Spite looks at Otataral Island, fires still spin around the fingers of the colossal jade hands
Spite turns wests and gives thanks to whoever saved them
[Note: Ganoes Paran]
Ganoes collapses onto gravel and rolls onto his back, looking up at his soldiers including Fist Rythe Bude and Noto Boil
Fist Rythe Bude asks if he just saved the world
‘If I saved the world - and by no means would I make such a claim - I am already regretting it. Does anyone have some water?’
Ganoes thinks about the promise he made with Hood
[Note: The bargain resulted in Hood bringing Heboric back which saved the world]

There have been moon details and vague references about war of the gods in the sky, but the fall of the jade suns was sort of a spontaneous event. So we have our answer in Heboric’s vision from House of Chains:
A vast – impossibly vast – red-limned wound cut across the blackness, suppurating flames along its ragged edges. Grey storms of chaos spiralled out in lancing tendrils.
And the giants descended into its maw. One after another. To vanish. Revelation filled his mind.
Thus, the Crippled God was brought down to our world. Through this . . . this terrible puncture.
And these giants . . . follow. Like an army behind its commander.
Or an army in pursuit.
The jade suns were Jade Giants searching for the Cripple God.
Ganoes accidentally called Hood (when he tried calling Mael) and makes a deal which results in Hood bringing Heboric back from the dead.
Heboric realizes he’s a Shield Anvil, not a Destriant, and so he assumes the sorrow of the millions of souls in the falling jade suns, weakening the power of the impact and saving the world.
Fist Keneb, Nether, and Nil watched the green suns descend
Keneb felt at peace with having a death out of his control
Nether says a god is manipulating the Malazan fleet by moving the winds with urgency
[Note: The Eres’al]
Keneb recalls the history of the Nemil Kingdom conquering the lands of the Trell, pushing them from the coastlands further inland
[Note: From Mappo’s memory, the Trell lost despite their superior strength because Nemil slaughtered their bhederin and starved them]
Nemil sages foresaw the Malazans coming, merchants were ready to make profits from the resupply but cancelled due to the jade suns
The Nemil traders has been defending themselves against the Tiste Edur for two years
Nether and Adjunct Tavore discuss the Perish people that the Malazans know nothing about
The Nemil wouldn't talk about the Perish. Fist Keneb thinks the arrogant expansionist Nemil kingdom fear facing the Perish
A severely damaged Edur fleet was sighted to the north. Nether guessed they faced and lost against the Perish
The Malazan Imperial Fleet were sailing through the Catal Inlet, still moving at speeds faster than ideal sailing conditions
Keneb says he wishes he could trip up some gods, Tavore hints she knows someone who's already done that
Kalam and Quick Ben get out of hiding between the crates, Kalam is concerned QB got drunk and pissed himself
Quick Ben reveals he was present as a corpse in Hood’s Gate, planning to bargain with Hood but instead witnessed Ganoes bargain with Hood
Quick Ben felt comfort being a corpse in the gate. Kalam feels like he would be too. Thinks they're both insane.
Quick Ben heard millions of voices in the jade suns
‘Enormous pieces of stone. Jade, sailing down from the stars. And in those broken mountains or whatever they were souls, millions of souls.’
Fist Tene Baralta had his own room in the ship to recover apart from his loyal Red Blades
The man was vain and became depressed and bitter following his scars, disfigurement, and loss of an eye. The other eye had blurred vision
Thinks Tavore set up Y’Ghatan to betray and get rid of the Red Blades
Thinks himself worthy as being as legendary and worshiped as Coltaine
His only company was a rat [Note: Probably belongs to Bottle]
Gethol, Herald of High House Chains, comes to soothe Tene Baralta’s pain and proposes a bargain to restore his eye
Gethol tells Tene Baralta he is destined for greatness and that Empress Laseen waits for him the most out of everyone else
Lostara Yil, in her bunk among the Red Blades outside Tene Baralta’s chamber, hears him have the conversation
Thinks it's because of how damaged he is after Y’Ghatan
‘Muscles of his frame sagging into fat, the twisted face began to droop, growing flaccid where there were no taut scars. Pallid skin, strands of hair thick with old sweat’
Regrets Cotillion giving her freedom, now is chained back to the Red Blades

The west coast of the Catal Inlet sea was lined with fjords, high black cliffs, dark green coniferous tree, and red tailed ravens flying above [Note: Drastic biome change from the desert and plains of the Seven Cities, still the same land mass]

The Perish fleet had 31 crafts, each ‘throne of war’ was a catamaran [Note: boxy ship with two hulls] with dromons each of its two hull. The flagship had a flag with a wolf on a black field and grey border
The Perish wore iron helms with camails at the back, sweeping cheek guards
Grey cloaks, surcoats of oiled chain, leather gauntlets
A war canoe came to the Froth Wulf with armored soldiers and three passengers, all fair skinned
The Perish Grey Helms are sworn to the Wolves of War, Togg and Fanderay
Krughava, Mortal Sword
Tall woman with broad shoulders. Iron grey hair, blue eyes, weathered face with scars, angular yet robust bone structure. Carries a silver wolfs heart pommel longsword
Tanakalian, Shield Anvil
Young man, straw blonde hair, deep grey eyes, broader shoulders
Run’Thurvian, Destriant
Tall, gaunt man, bald. The only one not wearing armor, just a dark grey woollen robe
The Perish greet and welcome the Mezla, speaking the Malazan language well
The Perish fought the Tiste Edur, lost four ships but destroyed twenty of the enemies
The Perish have been waiting for the Malazans
Krughava pledges the Perish Grey Helms, an army of 13,079, to Adjunct Tavore’s service until death, then places her sword at Tavore’s feet
Kalam and Quick Ben watch from above
Quick Ben mutters to himself, recognizes who the Perish are, and needs to talk to Tavore
Run’Thurvian looks up and smiles politely at Quick Ben, scaring him
Kalam sarcastically calls Quick Ben ‘High Mage Ben Adaephon Delat, High Lord of Diction’
Felisin Younger, as Sha’ik Reborn in Hanar Ara the City of the Fallen, has grown fat as she’s been given in excess food, wine, rustleaf, and lovemaking
Kulat, the Crippled God’s servant from Barathol’s village, justified every concern Felisin Younger had
Mental gymnastics that absolute servitude would be rewarded with absolute indolence in the next life
Yet Kulat convinced her that as Sha'ik Reborn she need not worry about being a servant in her next life
Mathok arrives to deliver the Book of Dryjhna and his rebel army in service to Sha’ik Reborn
Instead, Felisin Younger orders to disband the army, disregard the old book, and start a new Book of Salvation
Mathok drops the Book of Dryjhna, breaking it to Kulat’s horror, and leaves with the army in disgust
Felisin Younger smiles, happy with herself
The Malaz 5th Army crossed paths with Mathok’s army
[Note: Hanar Ara is speculated to be E’napatha N’apur, somewhere northeast of G’danisban]
Mathok concludes the rebellion has ended and immediately surrenders
Ganoes is not interested in punishing them and let's them go free to do whatever they want
Mathok warns Ganoes of the religion offering salvation to the maimed and broken where you have to die first
Even though Ganoes knows it would be the wise decision, can’t bring himself to slaughter a bunch of cripples and leaves Hanar Ara alone
Mathok persuades Ganoes to accept the rebel army into the Malazan army, because they have no home or family to return to and die in misery
Ganoes accepts the army and makes Mathok a Fist, not able to turn away an army volunteering 4,000 veterans
Orders Mathok to organize his army in the Malazan fashion, mounted troops in units of 50, 100, and 300
Ganoes has Noto Boil fetch Ormulogan - ‘Again?’ - so that he can create a new Unaligned card, Salvation
Salvation is currently in the House of Chains, but Ganoes has a feeling it’s going to free itself and become Unaligned and one of the most dangerous forces in the world
Ganoes likes Mathok, because they both know the best decision would be to slaughter Felisin Younger and her cult right now, but neither of them can do it
Hurlochel asks what Mathok meant by not recognizing Sha’ik Reborn
Mathok talks about how she’s the adoptive daughter of Sha’ik and reveals Sha’ik is actually a Malazan woman, laughing how Mezla killed Mezla
Hurlochel is saddened that Sha’ik was actually Malazan, but I don’t think he knows it was Felisin
[Note: Thus ignorance continues. Tavore kills her sister without knowing, and not even the name Felisin Younger is said to Ganoes]

[Note: Thus ends the plotline of Felisin Younger and the Apocalypse/Dryjhna/Whirlwind Rebellion/Etc etc. Also for some reason this is the last we ever see or hear of Hurlochel even though by all means I’m sure he’d be alive and present by the end of the series]

cards.h: Scene 4 (Sepik and Drift Avalii, Ahlrada Ahn)

i.html: Ahlrada Ahn is horrified but does nothing, witnessing the atrocities of murder and rape of the Sepik kingdom and enslavement of the Tiste Edur population here
Four leagues inland from the harbor city, late afternoon
20 Tiste Edur warriors and 40 Letherii marines
Among them were Tomad Sengar, Saur Bathrada, Kholn Harat, Sathbaro Rangar
Taralack Veed and Icarium also accompany them
Ahlrada Ahn wanted to commit suicide, but it would be a sign of weakness rather than protest, thus would be a futile death
The Tiste Edur expresses doubts against Icarium because he weeps
As Taralack Veed assures Icarium’s ability, Ahlrada Ahn can see the fear and nervousness in Taralack Veed’s eyes, Veed is frightened of Icarium
The warlock Sathbaro Rangar opens a portal to Drift Avalii, their test for Icarium is to take the Throne of Shadow
However, Drift Avalii seems to be abandoned
Taralack Veed asks what Icarium knows
Icarium senses Shadow demons left upon their arrival, and of another person that could kill Icarium
Walking further down were corpses of azalan demons and aptorians, the Edur had recovered their dead
Walking further down they reach a courtyard with a broken gate, Icarium halts Taralack Veed at the gate claiming there is no need
Through the courtyard and into the chamber, the Tiste Edur discover the Throne of Shadow destroyed, its blood-red heartwood exposed
The warlock, Sathbaro Rangar cries out. Kurald Emurlahn will never be whole again
Ahlrada Ahn drags Sathbaro to his feet and says there’s another Throne to be won
Sathbaro Rangar opens another portal, this time leading to the First Throne
Icarium laughs
‘Are you amused?’
‘Of Shadow both, the weaver deceives the worshipper.’
Shadowthrone releases the illusion of Mockra and Meanas he cast on the First Throne
‘Mockra, filaments of suggestion, invitation, the surrendering of natural scepticism, easing the way to witness the broken throne’
Shadowthrone surfaces and sees Icarium at the courtyard gate, smiling and nodding at ST

Fist Keneb listens as Run’Thurvian tells Adjunct Tavore about the three sorcerer kings of Shal-Morzinn, how they'll oppose the Malazans out of pleasure, and powerful enough to destroy them even with Quick Ben
Run'Thurvian suggests traveling the realm of Togg and Fanderay, currently the least violent season for their sea of storms and ice
The route reduces the journey from months to days
The Perish Grey Helms have planned for the Malazans two years in advance
Quick Ben reluctantly helps them
Kalam asks why Quick Ben looks scared and they speak privately in their secret spot between the crates and barrels
Quick Ben and Kalam don't know if they're taking sides with Adjunct Tavore
More complicated considering Kalam had planned to kill Laseen [Note: End of Deadhouse Gates] but ended up on her side
The Malazan Imperial Fleet and Perish throne of war ships all pass through the sorcerous gate and are in the realm of Togg and Fanderay
Rough seas, a coastline of deciduous and pine trees and seals
Fiddler is nauseous, Bottle is happy looking at the seals
The fall of the jade suns was visible from Malaz Island
Four dromon ships from the Jakatakan Fleet arrived into Malaz harbor, lost almost half their fleeting fighting against unknown barbarians [Tiste Edur]
Dropped off two Malazan soldiers and Tiste Andii that were stranded on an island
Speaking to Master Sgt. Braven Tooth, Banaschar learns the Malazan soldiers are Mudslinger and Gentur
[Note: Mudslinger and Gentur were part of the stranded Malazan crew including the Traveler and Hawl, Admiral Nok’s wife and former commander of the Talon.]
The Malazans fought the [Tiste Edur], got shipwrecked onto Drift Avalii, continued fighting the Tiste Edur alongside Tiste Andii that was already on the island
Traveler comes and tells them to leave or else they just get in the way
The Malazans and Tiste Andii get stranded on an island for months before they get picked up by the Jakatakan fleet
The Tiste Andii are all related to Anomander Rake
Nimander Golit is Rake’s son and elder of the group
Phaed is daughter to Nimander and Lady Envy, Envy wanted to get revenge on Rake
[Note: These characters are big for Toll the Hounds]

[Note: The Tiste Andii helped Andarist defend the Throne of Shadow on Drift Avalii from the Tiste Edur. After Andarist died, the Traveler showed up and sent everyone away so he could be the sole defender of the Throne.]
The Foreigner drinks Malaz Dark, doesn't join in on Banaschar and Braven Tooth’s conversation as he normally would, and just broods
[Note: This feels like a ‘hey remember i exist’ scene lmao]
Cartheron Crust sailed on the Drowned Rat with his first mate Pate and Vole on the crow’s nest as lookout
Cartheron sees Mock’s Hold and thinks Lubben’s still guarding the gate and hiding whenever there were uninvited guests, and Fist Aragan is lying low during the unofficial pogrom against the Wickans
Vole spots four dromons, the Surly being the lead flagship. Empress Laseen is here
[Note: The ships that picked up and dropped off the Malazans and Tiste Andii were probably with Laseen]

[Note: Cartheron Crust is one of the dead Napan brothers that “drowned” when Surly usurped the Malazan Empire. He was captain of the Ragstopper that transported Kalam and Pearl to Malaz City in Deadhouse Gates. Toc the Younger is his nephew.]
The Malazan Imperial Fleet have left Togg and Fanderay’s realm and are sailing Malazan waters
The Jakatakan Fleet led by Commander Exent Hadar was commanded by Empress Laseen to intercept the imperial fleet and send them to Malaz City instead of Unta
Adjunct Tavore reprimands Hadar’s marines for touching their swords while giving nasty looks at Nether and Nil
Fist Keneb feels proud to be with Tavore
Hadar explains there were ‘revelations’ accusing the Wickans of complicity in the slaughter of Pormqual’s army. Barely hides his disrespect
Kalam recognize one of Hadar’s marines as Claw and watch as the Jakatakan fleet sails away swiftly
The Malazan Imperial Fleet spent only 3 days in Togg and Fanderay’s realm, only the Malaz boats were damaged but nothing severe and no casualties. The Perish ships were unscathed
Kalam, Quick Ben, and Apsalar are on edge because they're undecided on whose side they belong to: with or against Laseen
Sgt. Fiddler as horrified as the Jakatakan fleet sails past their boat as Koryk, Smiles, Tarr, and Cuttle stand along the railing and hold a Tiste Andii head in their arms to greet the ships
Cpl. Stormy runs to the railing and shits off the side, the Tiste Andii heads are amused
As Bottle was feeding out a line for fish, he suddenly gets nauseous and runs to the opposite rail
Lt. Pores and Cpt. Kindly are disgusted by Cpl. Stormy
The soldiers on the Jakatan fleet were silent and horrified
Cpt. Kindly calls them weak because they're ‘Untan coddled nobleborn pups’ whose uniforms have only been stained by gull shit
Kindly sends Pores to go stop two of their own heavies from shitting off the side like Stormy
All the ships of the Malaz 14th Army participated in shitting off the sides as they passed the Jakatakan ships
Adjunct Tavore and Admiral Nok did nothing to stop it
Run'Thurvian comes out and speaks with Fist Keneb who explains the action was more for rivalry and points at the Silanda for starting it
Run'Thurvian senses several warrens on the Silanda
Kurald Emurlahn (Tiste Edur), Tellann (T’lan Imass), Telas (human path of fire), and remnants of Toblakai (Karsa Orlong)
Run'Thurvian recalls knowledge of Toblakai individuals that became powerful enough to become warrens themselves
The power is rare as the Perish believed Toblakai extinct
Aware of mixed blood races like in the Fenn range of Quon Tali, Trell, and Barghast
Run'Thurvian is worried if Adjunct Tavore’s relationship with Empress Laseen was strained because he doesn't think the Malaz 14th Army is strong enough to face the Malazan Empire
Kalam and Quick Ben are unable to sleep, on the deck looking at Malaz City, getting the same feeling as Pale
Adjunct Tavore appears and orders Quick Ben to travel via warren to the Silanda and fetch Fiddler and Bottle to play one of his [Deck of Dragons] games
Quick Ben wakes up Bottle and Fiddler and takes them via warren to the map room in the Froth Wolf
Despite Fiddler and T’amber not feeling like it's a good idea, Tavore moves on regardless
[Note: I dunno most of what’s going on besides the obvious]
Fiddler is the dealer and admits he makes up the rules as he goes
Seating order clockwise: Fiddler > Apsalar > Kalam > Keneb > Tavore > T’amber > Quick Ben > Bottle
Everyone gets wine. The dealer gets rum
Bottle serves the alcohol and doesn’t sit down
Quick Ben gets a card first, is the final card of the game, not shown until the end
Bottle hands cups to: Tavore, T’amber, Keneb, QB, Kalam, Apsalar, Fiddler, himself
Fiddler deals 8 face-up cards in that order
Bottle does not sit down yet
Fiddler, Soldier of High House Life. Bittersweet, for him and him alone given the late hour
Empty Chair (Bottle didn’t sit down after handing out cups), Weaver of Life
Kalam, Obelisk. Reversed field, nothing to be done for it
Burn, the Sleeping Goddess
Apsalar, Assassin of High House Shadow (Cotillion)
Quick Ben, Lifeslayer (Icarium) to deal with. Puts him in a hole, but a different hole
T’amber. Throne, shifting every which way, the pivot/hinge card
Keneb, Lord of Wolves, High House War

Sgt. Fiddler asks where Grub is, Keneb says is on Nok’s ship, Fiddler says Keneb is knocked out of the game but still gets four more course since they’ve made a course correction. Closer to the coast, Grub will dive overboard. He’s got three friends living the caves in the cliff
Crown
Sceptre
Orb
Ignores the 3 cards for now
‘Relax, he’ll be back’
Tavore, Guardians of the Road of High House War (the Bridgeburners)
Fiddler deals the Oponn card next to Tavore’s card
Decisions yet to be made, Push or Pull?
Fiddler deals Herald of High House Death opposite QB and Kalam, a distinctively inactive and out of date card
Rusty Gauntlet, a drink mix of rum and wine that Bottle accidentally poured and Fiddler dubbed for the game
Fiddler deals four cards
Spinner of Death, ???
Queen of Dark, Mother Dark
Queen of Life, Queen of Dreams
King in Chains, Rhulad
Fiddler asks Keneb about his wife, but forget it because she set him aside for an Untan noble, possibly Exent Hadar
Bottle, Deathslayer of High House War
Bottle is done and gets to sleep
How does Kalam get from Herald of Death (the inactive and out of date version) to Obelisk (Burn)?
Answer: King of High House Shadow (Shadowthrone)
Who’s gone all chilled in here? Kalam, T’amber, Apsalar raises their hand
Aspalar get’s the bottles now that Bottle is corked
T’amber gets Virgin of Death
Kalam doesn’t get another card
Quick Ben gets Consort in Chains (Poliel) but saved sister so not as bad as it could’ve been
Fiddler and Tavore and the last ones. Tavore is neither hot or cold.
Fiddler drinks his Rusty Gauntlet, Apsalar refills his cup
Fiddler deals Master of the Deck onto the first card (Quick Ben’s card)
Fiddler deals Priest of Life, the game is done
Nobody wins, that’s Life for you
Quick Ben’s face down card closed the game, does not get turned over
Fiddler leaves, then Apsalar, then Quick Ben and Kalam. Bottle was asleep under the table.
Tavore, impatient, flips Quick Ben’s card. Knight of Shadow (Trull Sengar, defending the Throne of Shadow)
T’amber did not paint the card
T’amber has never seen a Deck reading so chaotic (not elemental Chaos). More like a rock bouncing, striking true everywhere it hit
Announcements from above that the Malaz Imperial Fleet is now in sight of Malaz Harbour
Tavore orders Fist Keneb that he commands the Malaz 14th Army
No one except those who Tavore chooses can disembark
All the ships will stay in the harbour, except the Froth Wolf, ignore anyone’s else orders to tie the fleet up to the piers
If Empress Laseen gives any orders, Fist Keneb is to feign misunderstanding and not follow them no matter what
Tavore wants the Wickans, Khundryl Burned Tears, and Perish to be safe away from Malaz City
Keneb thinks of a possible civil war, Tavore doesn’t think it will go that far
T’amber kicks Bottle to try to wake up him, but Tavore wants to leave him there to speak with him privately
Fist Keneb is dismissed
Pearl looks at the Throne of War catamarans from Mock’s Hold
Empress Laseen appears

Senses that Run’Thurvian his holding back his power as if he anticipates something far more dangerous coming
Senses several warren traps in the city streets using High Ruse, the path of the sea
As Quick Ben opens and enters a warren, a voice says
‘You said you owed me, remember? Well, my dear Snake, it’s time’
[Note: Quick Ben’s debt to Shadowthrone]
After a minute, Kalam figures the summoning failed and accepts his imminent death
Kalam runs across the bridge and climbs an old estate wall onto the roof to look over the maze that is the Mouse Quarter, and is immediately ambushed by the largest Claws he’s ever seen
Kalam keeps running, never stopping, parrying, snaps a Claw’s neck, hops an alley onto the next roof
x9 Claws are chased him and formed a semicircle
Kalam impales one’s heart ☠
, stabs into a second’s brain ☠
, runs into the semi-circle’s flank, someone slashes Kalam’s leg, and Kalam stabs a third’s eye
Tackles another Claw and grabs his leg to toss him up to fall into a Claw behind them. Kalam elbows the second Claw’s head crushing it ☠
then stab’s the first Claw’s neck ☠
A Claw impales Kalam’s right thigh, Kalam kicks his stomach sending him airborne
Kalam intercept’s a Claw’s dagger and bends the Claw’s hand to make him eviscerate himself ☠
Kalam pulls out the dagger from his thigh and uses it to parry
Facing three Claw, he throws both long knives impaling two in the chest ☠☠
and tackles the center Claw to break his arm and stomp his face into the roof ☠
Pearl watched Kalam slaughter the Claw, then fires his poisoned bolt into Kalam’s left arm
Kalam falls into a hole in the roof
Pearl goes to collect Kalam’s weapons and tells the one surviving Claw to gather the rest of the Claw to the harbor to face Adjunct Tavore, assures that Kalam is dead
The surviving Claw is disgusted that Pearl used Kartoolian Paralt, dishonoring himself
No priest left on the island that can neutralize the poison
Pearl kills the Claw with White Paralt
Pearl thinks about what to do next, aims to kill Mallick Rel and Korbolo Dom before the night is over
Fiddler stops playing the music, feeling empty
Gesler answers a knock at the door, says it’s for Stormy
Legana Breed, the T’lan Imass, has come back for his flint sword
Stormy gives it back to him, Legana Breed jokes that it’s scratched
Gesler demands repayment since they kept Legana Breed’s secret from the other T’lan Imass
[Note: Legana Breed took a Tiste Andii head to seal the rift in the Nascent in place of himself so he could escape]
Gesler wants an escort back to the harbor, Legana Breed jokes that he just came from there and that tonight he is also a marine.
Four thousand people on the way to the docks, all driven mad from chaotic sorcery
Let us go kill people
Fiddler and Braven Tooth bid farewell
Throatslitter begs Fist Keneb to call in more soldiers from the fleet in the harbor
Keneb knows if they do, they’ll be in too deep that they can’t get themselves out, understands why Adjunct Tavore doesn’t explain things
Run’Thurvian senses Claw are on the way, targeting Nil and Nether whose power is not for them yet
Fist Keneb calls on the rest of the soldiers to protect Nil and Nether
Sends Smiles to find Quick Ben, but QB isn’t there
Cuttle ties a cusser to the ballista
A bell in Malaz City rings four times
Lt. Pores and Cpt. Kindly watch the battle from the anchored fleet
Pores wants to join the fight to help their fellow soldiers, but Kindly will not disobey orders
A cloth-wrapped figure [Note: Apsalar] jumps to Kalam’s corpse
The vengeful spirit of the Claw that Pearl killed with White Paralt tell the cloth-wrapped figure that Kalam pulled the quarrel out. Enough Kartoolian Paralt on the tip to kill Pearl
[Apsalar] takes the quarrel and leaves
[Apsalar] moves swiftly through the city to the harbor
Evades the High Ruse traps, ignores the mentally corrupting invitations of Mockra, and into the shadowed paths of Rashan the Claw used to hide in
Closer to the harbor, Apsalar began killing Claw
Pearl sees his rearguard Claw crumple and runs away in a panic, thinking a Shadow Dancer is coming for him
Pearl attempts to use his warrens. Mockra, Rashan, imperial, etc. but none of them work
Apsalar slices Pearl’s achilles tendon, hamstrings, and elbows. Lifts him up and crushes his face against a wall, then cuts out his tongue and stabbed his stomach with the Kartoolian paralt
Apsalar reveals Pearl was an idiot for holding onto Kalam’s otataral longknife, and that he was her final target [by Cotillion]
Pearl suffers from the Kartoolian paralt as Aspalar walks away
Apsalar meets with Shadowthrone on Admiral Bridge
Shadowthrone remarks her Shadow Dance is more impressive than Cotillion
Apsalar alone had taken out 307 Claw, little more than half of the 600 Laseen prepared
Shadowthrone keeps his promise and let’s Apsalar go free
Apsalar hands Shadowthrone Kalam’s weapon and she crosses the bridge
Shadowthrone makes a detour to knock on Obo’s Tower and let him know Oponn is on the roof
Shortly after Obo casts fireball to expel the twin gods
Fiddler, Gesler, Stormy, and Legana Breed approached the harbor as they hear sharpers being used in the battle
Sgt. Hellian and Banaschar walks out of the bar, super drunk of demon ale
Hellian faces Legana Breed and tells Fiddler he looks awful
Gesler, Stormy, and Legana Breed walk ahead, but run back because of a mob
[Note: A Tavore POV?!]
Tavore and T’amber were getting closer to the harbor, as they’re forced to fight three squads of City Guards, and about 20+ Claw on the way
Tavore slices off a City Guard’s knee cap
T’amber swiftly kills several City Guards until she is impaled by a sword and tossed away into the street
T’avore raises her otataral sword as the City Guards and Claw rush her
A Moranth munition detonates, Fiddler collects and drags Tavore, one of her boots falls off
Gesler and Stormy are firing off their oversized crossbows
Legana Breed kills everyone in his path, taking in all the virulent sorcery attacks
Hellian and Banaschar are drunk
They’re drunk, the both of them - well, on this night. I think I’ll let it pass
Oh, T’amber….
Tavore loses consciousness
Grub guides Lostara Yil to Pearl, moaning Lostara’s name in love
Grub asks Lostara to kill him out of mercy, as the Karoolian paralt keeps the victim alive as long as possible to feed on rich blood and the stomach acids burn him from the inside
Lostara Yil sinks her knife between the shoulder blades. Pearl dies ☠
Grub guides Lostara Yil further towards the harbour and touches her hand
Grub and Lostara Yil see the Eres’al, crouched next to T’amber’s body
T’amber’s body glows with golden light. Wind that smells of warm and dry savannah grasses blow in the wind
Legana Breed is nearby, turns towards the Eres’al and kneels before her
The Eres’al kisses T’amber’s forehead to thank her, T’amber dies ☠
Grub tells her Lostara Yil must keep this secret from Tavore, along with the other secret that Tavore killed Felisin
Grub insists that the Malaz 14th Army is going to war and they must follow. Lostara Yil needs to stay by Tavore’s side, not as her lover, but just so that she doesn’t do this alone
Grub leads her to the Mouse Quarter despite Lostara wanting to go to the harbor
Fiddler arrives with Tavore, Deadsmell goes to heal her but the otataral has already healed her
Fiddler reports Bottle, Quick Ben, and Kalam are missing
Tavore believes that everything has failed, since Bottle was supposed to retrieve [the Foreigner]

Immediately, a small craft carrying Grub, the Foreigner revealed to be Withal, his wife Sandalath Drukorlat, Bottle, Nimander Golit, the other Tiste Andii that had defended the Throne of Shadow on Drift Avalii, and Cartheron Crust
Grub greets his father as Fist Keneb lifts him up
Cartheron Crusts comes aboard and asks for 16 gold imperials, Adjunct Tavore has Keneb go to the legion paychest and insist on 200 gold imperials
Sandalath Drukorlat tells Tavore that Withal has been waiting a long time, says what is to come belongs to the Tiste Andii as much, if not more, than Tavore
Tavore welcomes the Tiste Andii
Bottle explains he just followed his rat Y’Ghatan to find him a boat and it led him to Cartheron Crust
Adjunct Tavore explains to Nether and Nil that the Wickan Plains needs them to defend against the Malazan pogrom, Tavore will do everything she can to accommodate the Wickans and thanks them
Nether goes to Bottle and tells him ‘When you are done, come back’
Fiddler turns to Malaz City and bids Kalam farewell

cards.h: The Foreigner revealed to be Withal

i.html: Withal is a human Meckros swordsmith that the Crippled God recruited to make the cursed sword which granted Rhulad his immortality and path to becoming the emperor the Tiste Edur and of the Letherii Empire. He was granted three Nacht servants (Jaghut creations) named Rind, Maps, and Pule.
Withal met Rhulad Sengar every time he had died in the Crippled God’s warren, before being revived.

Sandalath Drukorlat was a Tiste Andii woman that fought under Scabandari Bloodeye when they invaded the mortal realm. Sandalath died before the actual betrayal and thus did not serve as a wraith slave to the Edur, but her soul was still bound. When Seren Pedac traveled with the Crimson Guard, they escaped the Tiste Edur through Kurald Galain and summoned Sandalath as a guide. When the Crimson Guard tried to reunite her ring with Sandalath’s dead body so her soul would be freed, she instead was summoned by the Crippled God to be Withal’s companion. They had a very antagonistic relationship while on the island.

While in the warren, Withal made several prayers to Mael, Elder God of the Seas and also masquerading as the manservant, Bugg. At the end of Midnight Tides, Mael comes to the Crippled God’s warren and provides a boat for Withal, Sandalath Drukorlat, and the three Nachts to escape.

T’amber, under the guidance of the Eres’al, helped Bottle create a doll used as a reference to find Withal in Malaz City. Withal is to serve as an informant to Adjunct Tavore everything he knows about the Crippled God and Emperor Rhulad.
Kalam suffers from the Kartoolian paralt, attempts to crawl around but fails and is too confused to know where he is
Shadowthrone yells at Kalam, the three wraiths that were playing Troughs with the whore at Smiley’s also comes
One of the wraiths claims Kalam is dead
Shadowthrone has the wraiths drag him to the Deadhouse, where its guardian huffs and drags Kalam in
[Note: The Deadhouse guardian was last known to the Gothos, it could be Gothos or some unnamed character]
Shadowthrone leaves immediately as [Coop’s Hanged Man Inn]’s door slams open
Braven Tooth approached Coop’s Hanged Man Inn as Temper walks out of the tavern wearing his monstrous armor
[Note: After the events of Night of Knives, Temper is the guardian of the Deadhouse]
Temper said he thought he’d just take a walk, Braven Tooth jokes he’s dressed appropriately
[Apsalar] walks right past them into the tavern, after a moment the two head back inside
Moments before dawn
Fist Aragan sits in the corner, watches Apsalar order a bottle of Kanese Rice Wine
Braven Tooth tries to hurt on her but she wields a knife to his eye and then heads upstairs alone
Ahlrada Ahn leads the Edur, Letherii, Tarack Veed, and Icarium through this realm between realms
A blasted landscape of mud and corpses, everything is sheather in a layer of clay with arms and feet jutting from the ground
Flashes of sorcery and battle are seen in the distance as they travel in silence
Taralack Veed reflects upon his culture the world sees as primitive and backwards
His ambition was to slaughter an entire culture, then tempered to lord power to rule one
Ahlrada Ahn calls for a rest
Icarium voices respect for the man, Taralack Veed has suspicions of him because he can tell Ahlrada Ahn is dying his skin lighter
Icarium retorts that it must take a deceiver to know one, voices his distrust and views Taralack Veed as his keeper who sees Icarium as a weapon
No longer sees or treats Taralack Veed as a friend
Cpt. Varat Taun, Letherii human second to Atri-Preda Yan Tovis, helped move along the Letherii
Despite how grim the Letherii Empire was under Tiste Edur rule, life was still quite decent in Letheras
Wishes he could be home with his wife and daughter
Hoped the journey would prove himself as a capable leader and gain Yam Tovis’ respect
Varat Taun is Bluerose and recognized Ahlrada Ahn to be the same and wonders if he conceals his heritage to survive
Ahead on the road were figures with pikes marching toward the distant battle
Sathbaro Rangar immediately calls to leave
Steth and Aystar; 10 year old brother and 9 year old sister, weren't allowed to fight despite their insistence and being issued armor of the company of Shadow
The siblings player their favorite game, sneaking up on Onrack
Aystar gets caught and hugs Onrack, he pets her head
Steth stands on a boulder to impress Onrack about how he tried to hunt a rat
Onrack tells him to be careful and immediately an arrow impales Steth’s head, dropping him to the floor dead ☠
Onrack shoves the screaming and crying Aystar behind him and shields from raining arrows
Trull Sengar is exhausted, defending an empty throne against T’lan Imass (the Unbound), Tiste Edur (his own people), and Letherii
All they had was Trull, Onrack, Minala, Monok Ochem, Ibra Gholan, Panek, Apt, and the remaining Seven Cities children
Aystar runs screaming her brother was killed
Onrack is currently fighting them
Trull meets Ibra Gholan about halfway, informing the Edur brought humans and a shaman
Trull urges to immediately kill the warlock because of the Chaotic sorcery they use
The Edur face Onrack at a choke point in the fissure environment, three Edur are dead
Sathbaro Rangar, the warlock, has everyone step back as he casts a silvery wave, the build up cracking the rock walls around them, and released
The wave of sorcery dissipates uselessly on Monok Ochem’s Soletaken ape form
Monok Ochem rushes to Rangar to grab him, lift him up, tear an arm off, and then biting his neck and pulling out his spinal column whipping out like a chain ☠
Monok Ochem charges towards Ahlrada Ahn
Icarium looks sorrowfully at Steth’s dead body, only moving when he sees Ahlrada Ahn courageously facing Monok Ochem alone
Icarium approached, hearing a song in his head that faded away
Icarium flung Ahlrada Ahn back, Monok Ochem immediately recognizing Icarium
The Edur run through the chokepoint
Ahlrada Ahn passes the chokepoint to find two T’lan Imass and Trull Sengar who fights to protect the children soldiers
Kholb Harat recognized Trull and shouts
Ahlrada Ahn runs forward
Trull defended himself against two Tiste Edur he recognized and was about to fall
Ahlrada Ahn cuts off Kholb Harat’s head ☠
and suffers a thigh cut from Saur Bathrada
Trull impales Saur’s forehead, his eyes pop out of its sockets ☠
Ahlrada Ahn begs for amends and to fight on his side
Trull doesn't understand but welcomes him
A sound was becoming overwhelming in everyone’s heads. Icarium is coming
Onrack (T’lan Imass) faces of against Icarium (half-Jhag) that's completely blinded by fury
Icarium’s high pitched moan physically pushed Onrack a step back
Onrack parries Icarium’s sword strike and ripostes to strike Icarium’s neck
Icarium blocks the riposte and punched his chest and sends him flying to impact the wall
Icarium walks towards Minala and the children
Onrack tries to tackle Icarium waist but bounces off his body and knocked onto the floor
Icarium grabs Onrack’s chest and throws him hard against the wall again, Onrock stops moving
Icarium turns and faces the Tiste Edur and Letherii

cards.h: Scene 10, 11 (The First Throne, Ahlrada Ahn/Varat Taun)

i.html: Icarium's wail turns into a whirlwind around him, tossing around corpses of the children as he slaughters five of the Edur ☠☠☠☠☠
Ahlrada Ahn grabs Trull’s arm and apologizes for the Shorning
Minala, with a spear impaled in her chest, asks where Monok Ochem is
Trull point to the First Throne room, where Ibra Gholan stands at the door
Beyond Icarium was a gate showing a killing field and a ship on rocking seas
Icarium approached and attacked Trull
Trull is only able to defend himself by parrying with his spear
Ahlrada Ahn attempts to attack with dual cutlasses but it knocked back into the air and chest burst open
Cpt. Varat Taun watched with amazement as Trull was able to stand his ground and continue blocking Icarium
Turned and saw Taralack Veed sobbing like a bitch trying to dig his way out
Trull’s spear broke and jumped back, dodging a slash that would've decapitated him
Apt lunges and bits onto Icarium’s shoulder and claws across his body
Icarium slashes through Apt’s throat, Apt dies ☠
with her claws in a death grip around his shoulder
Trull drags Ahlrada Ahn to the First Throne room

cards.h: Scene 12, 13, 14, 15 (The First Throne, Trull/Quick Ben/Varat Taun)

i.html: In the chamber, Trull sees Monok Ochem was destroyed by Icarium’s winds and had melted into the First Throne, Monok Ochem ☠
The children including Panek were laying around the Minala
Ibra Gholan approaches Icarium
Ahlrada Ahn says the word Home the moment before he dies ☠
Trull picks up a spear off the ground
Icarium rips the dead Apt off his shoulder as Ibra Gholan attacks
Ibra Gholan manages to push Icarium back two steps
Icarium shatters the flint sword and shatters Ibra Gholan’s entire body swing by swing
Quick Ben is summoned by Shadowthrone and unleashed blinding sorcery onto Icarium, pushing him out of sight
[Note: Shadowthrone intercepted Kalam summoning Quick Ben using the acorn]
Varat Taun watches as Icarium walks back and gets hit by a second thunderous sorcerous attack
Quick Ben repeatedly hammers sorcery into Icarium, bodies getting knocked into the air and being stripped of its skin, flesh, and bone before withering into nothing
Quick Ben screams ‘Who in Hood’s name is that man?’ at Trull
Icarium began to withstand against Quick Ben’s sorcery, and then pushed his own force against Quick Ben
Quick Ben is knocked back, skids on the floor to Trull
Quick Ben’s entire body had ruptured, entire body coated in his blood, bloodshot eyes as blood fell in tears down his face
Quick Ben says it's all up to [Trull] now and he'll be waiting for Shadowthrone and Cotillion on the other side of Hood’s gate
The Eres'al appears behind Icarium in a healing golden glow, lightly brushes Icarium’s right hip, and Icarium crumples to the ground unconscious
The Eres'al disappears
Trull drags Quick Ben into the First Throne room
Taralack Veed yells at Varat Taun to help him drag Icarium through the gate before it closes
Icarium is truly capable of killing Emperor Rhulad. Varat Taun sees hope and helps
Cotillion appears in the First Throne room, he would've stepped in when Quick Ben was finished
It has been an eventful night. Such is convergence
Ibra Gholan was mended by the Eres'al’s healing light, walks in to say Icarium was dragged away
Cotillion blamed the Nameless Ones
Shadowthrone comes to heal Minala, Quick Ben, and other injured
Trull asserts all those who have defended the First Throne will do so no longer
Cotillion says of course not. Then sits down and rests his head on his hands
Trull thanks the dead Ahlrada Ahn
Crokus is on the boat sailing away in the Otataral Sea with Scillara, Barathol, Chaur, Mappo, Iskaral Pust, and Mogora
Mappo weeps
Crokus talks about how beautifully she danced at a fete at Coll’s estate celebrating the Malazan's withdrawal
At sea, Samar Dev wants some of the white bear pelt because its cold and Karsa gives her the whole pelt
Samar Dev overhears the news about another champion, Icarium, had slaughtered the Edur around him. Only a Letherii and his Gral servant survived
Samar Dev wants to get the hell of the ship
Karsa recounts how he met Icarium once before but their battle was interrupted. He is excited to fight him again, to Samar’s dismay
On another boat, Icarium is confused by the Edur who hated him now worship him
Icarium treats Taralack Veed friendly, despite Taralack being nothing but bitter and venomous to him
In the highest tower of Mock’s Hold, Tayschrenn watches Tavore’s fleet depart
Shadowthrone visits him, Tayschrenn greets him as Emperor and has been aware of everything that's going on. Plans in the long term view
Banaschar hired a ship Tayschrenn owned without knowing
Tayschrenn is still a priest of D’rek, talked her out of killing him
Tayschrenn schemed with Quick Ben and Kalam, even traveling to Seven Cities to meet them
Tayschrenn is QB’s shaved knuckle in the hole, but intends to be used for something far bigger than Icarium
Shadowthrone weeps for the Wickans
Tayschrenn assures Nether, Nil, and Temul will be enough. Decades from now, an adult Temul will raise a young warrior named Coltaine
[Note: Left up to interpretation is this is reincarnation or spiritual successor]
Confirms that Shadowthrone was scared of Temper
Cackles with glee that dragging Kalam into the Deadhouse is not enough to save him
The Master Investigator of Kartool reports his findings to the Malazan commander of Kartool
Concludes the D’rek priests all simultaneously had an orgy suicide
The Nameless Ones summon Dejim Nebrahl, an ancient terror that is a d’ivers whose form is several t’rohlbahl (scaled panther)

Dejim Nebrahl attacks Mappo and Icarium, separating them. His original objective is complete, and then gets hunted down by Deragoth that Ganoes Paran released to specifically hunt and killed Dejim Nebrahl

Icarium is found by Taralack Veed, a Nameless One agent who gaslights Icarium into believing he’s a companion and guides him to be taken by the Tiste Edur and travel to Letheras to slay Emperor Rhulad
Meanwhile, Mappo is found by Spite and Iskaral Pust who decides to help him reunite with Icarium. Later after the fall of the suns, they meet up and join with Crokus’ group
As Master of the Deck, Ganoes learned the players in this war of the gods and came to Seven Cities to negate the threat of Dejim Nebrahl, summoned by the Nameless Ones
Ganoes goes to the Raraku Sea and summons the dead Bridgeburners, calls for Hedge, because the Bridgeburners can use the Raraku Sea as a gate to summon the Deragoth
Dejim Nebrahl completed its task of separating Mappo and Icarium, thus it hunts freely
With a Jaghut Ganath, Hedge, and the Trygalle Trade Guild, the party travels through the Jaghut underworld to the Nascent where they free the remaining Deragoth statues
Ganoes also summons Shadowthrone to send the Hounds to defeat Dejim Nebrahl and bring them to Seven Cities
Ganoes travels to G’danisban and joins Dujek’s Host, whose leadership is crippled by Poliel’s plague

Gigachad Ganoes waltzes into Poliel’s temple and binds her with a shard of otataral. The Hounds of Shadow drop Dejim Nebrahl in the temple, the Deragoth chase the Hounds and as a result destroy both Dejim Nebrahl and Poliel at once. The Deragoth seem to be still at large
Dujek dies and Ganoes becomes the next High Fist of the Malaz 5th Army by unanimous vote

Ganoes has Ormulogan paint a new Deck of Dragons, and to solve the problem of the falling jade suns, he summons Hood by accident and makes a deal to bring back Heboric who assumed the sorrow of the millions of souls within the jade suns and saved the world from the impact
Passing Hanar Ara, Ganoes forgives and takes in Mathok’s rebel army and spares Felisin Younger, the new Sha’ik Reborn. The Malaz 2nd Army heads towards Aren

Adjunct Tavore leads the Malaz 14th Army to chase Leoman and the remaining Apocalypse army. They are led into a trap, the Malaz army was lured into Y’Ghatan which was set on fire with casks of olive oil hidden in all of the city walls. Leoman escapes via the Queen of Dreams, the remaining Malaz army are split between those that went inside and those that stayed outside.

The Malaz 14th Army reconvenes west Sotka, Tavore dubbing the survivors the Bonehunters. They wait on the coast until Admiral Nok’s fleet arrives to pick them up and sail back to Quon Tali to receive further orders from Empress Laseen on the future of the army.

Because of Poliel’s plague cutting off resupply routes, the fleet is forced to sail west and circumnavigate the continent to return to Quon Tali. They encounter the Perish Grey Helms, sworn to the Wolves of War, that use their warren to fast travel from the Perish lands to Quon Tali in only 3 days.

In Quon Tali, Mallick Rel has spread rumors that the Wickans are traitors to blame for the death of Malazan heroes, why the Seven Cities campaign failed. To establish their own food supply, Laseen let’s the Malaz people commit genocide against the Wickans, so that they can use the Wickan Plains for farmland
Empress Laseen demands Tavore to hand over the Wickans and Seven Cities tribe for the Malaz people to murder
In Malaz City, after meeting with Empress Laseen, Tavore decides to abandon the Malazan Empire and fight legions of Claw back to the Malaz 14th Army
The Malaz 14th Army sails away, never to return

Karsa Orlong rescues Samar Dev and takes her back to the city. When going through her maps, Samar Dev mentions the Sepik kingdom that has their own slaves. Karsa decides to take it upon himself to travel to Sepik and free those slaves. His adventure gets immediately derailed when he meets Boatfinder, whose Anibar tribe was murdered by Tiste Edur.

When Karsa finds the Tiste Edur, Preda Hanradi Khalag is impressed and invites Karsa to return with them to Letheras because they’re looking for potential champions to slay the immortal Emperor Rhulad, Rhulad trying to find someone who can kill him and end his suffering. Karsa accepts
Heboric receives whispers and dreams by jade strangers that make him go to the Jade Statue in Otataral Island
Crokus was tasked by Cotillion to defend Heboric, Scillara, and Felisin Younger on their way
They are attacked by the Unbound T’lan Imass to prevent Heboric from reaching the Jade Statue and kidnap Felisin Younger

Shadowthrone and Cotillion planned to make Felisin Younger the next Sha’ik Reborn. However, the Crippled God got to her first. However, she decides by herself to end the cycle of Apocalypse and instead create a paradise
Crokus and Scillara are rescued by Barathol. Together they decide to bury Heboric’s body at the Jade Statue, then sail back home to Darujhistan
An event similar to the Fall of the Crippled God occurs, Heboric’s proximity to the Jade Statue triggers huge jade arms and domes to protect the world from the falling suns
Crokus, Scillara, Barathol, and Chaur meet up with Mappo and they sail to Darujhistan

names.n: the fall of the Crippled God
A rider with a light grey cloak
C O N V E R G E N C E
Hounds of Shadow Doan and Ganrod
Mael, Elder God of the Seas
Master of the Deck Ganoes Paran
one the subject of the other
